Du hältst die wichtigsten Informationen und Gesprächsergebnisse in HubSpot fest und sorgst so für eine gut vorbereitete Übergabe an unsere Sales Manager. Das bringst du mit Du bist immatrikuliert und kannst neben deinem Studium 20 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten. Du kannst regelmäßig in unserem Hamburger Office arbeiten. jobs.title: Product Manager, Music Content and Catalogue
jobs.description: Your mission You own what learners actually play. Our catalogue is the heart of the Skoove experience, and it is also our largest content cost and our most constrained resource. Every song in the app exists because someone negotiated the right to put it there, modelled what it would cost, and judged what it would do for the learner. That is your job. You own the songs in our piano learning apps end to end: which music we license, what it costs, what each licence permits, and what it does for our learners. Our didactics lead owns the teaching content, and the two of you decide together which songs carry the didactics. You work alongside a didactics lead and a content producer, and you are the voice of content in our product owner round. You bring the commercial and rights lens. They bring pedagogy and production. This is not an internally facing product role. You will sit across the table from music publishers and labels, model the deals, and understand what each licence allows in the app. Our CEO leads negotiations with you at the start and an external licensing advisor supports the specialist work. You grow into owning it. And you care about the music itself. Getting the songs people actually want to play into a learning app, at a cost that works, is one of the most satisfying puzzles in this company. You have a real passion for AI tools: prototyping, analysis, modelling, experimentation. You bring new thinking on AI-first product work and model that mindset for others. Your job Own the song catalogue for the Skoove apps: what we add, what we retire, and why. You have a point of view on which music learners want to play, and the evidence to back it. Co-own the song selection inside the didactics together with our didactics lead. Their pedagogy, your rights and catalogue view. Own the commercial modelling of content: licence cost per subscriber and per song, revenue share, catalogue coverage against learner value, and the conversion effect of licensed content. Own the rights picture: which repertoire we hold, under what terms and territories, and what each licence permits in the product. Keep the clearance gate current so no song ships uncleared. Represent us with publishers and labels. Prepare the position, evaluate term sheets, identify the assumptions worth challenging, and document the relationship. Supported by the CEO and an external advisor, with the aim of taking full ownership. Be accountable for contractual reporting to partners: usage reports in the agreed format by the contract deadline, payments, audits and disputes. Colleagues in Commercial and Finance build and contribute to those reports. You own that they land on time. Monitor usage against plan: usage share per publisher, dilution against targets, and act when the numbers move. Translate licensing constraints and opportunities into product decisions, and carry product's catalogue requests back into licensing. Own the content unit's backlog and work closely with the team's engineer to turn priorities into progress. Prototype with AI coding tools where you can rather than waiting for a sprint, and contribute to the product owner round, sharing context and supporting the other product owners when useful. Where is the role heading: You start with the catalogue and the licensing relationships we have. Over the first year you take full ownership of negotiations as the CEO steps back, and you shape how our content strategy scales across further products and partner apps. The right person wants to own a domain, not administer one. So entstehen Lösungen mit nachhaltiger Wirkung und genau das macht uns zu einem der führenden Anbieter im Bereich Cloud-Technologien.  Unser Anspruch ist es, echte Ergebnisse zu schaffen, die messbar Wirkung zeigen und Projekte nachhaltig voranbringen. Wir beraten nicht nur, sondern setzen um. Denn Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Wirkung zu erzielen, gehört für uns zusammen.  Bei uns zählen deine Expertise, deine Leidenschaft und deine Motivation, etwas zu bewegen. Unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen machen uns stark. Sie schaffen den Raum, in dem du dich einbringen und weiterentwickeln kannst.  Wenn du nicht nur mitlaufen, sondern wirklich etwas bewegen willst, bist du bei uns richtig.    Was du von uns hast   🎯  Purpose  – Deine Expertise einsetzen  📖

Your Profile Must-have: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftswissenschaften (oder vergleichbar) mit Schwerpunkt Finance, Accounting oder Auditing. Fundierte Berufserfahrung in einer namhaften Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft (Big4 ist ein Plus) oder im Group Accounting / Konzernrechnungswesen eines internationalen Konzern / Scale-ups. Umfassende Exzellenz und nachgewiesene Expertise in der bilanztechnischen Abbildung von IFRS. Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (C1/C2-Niveau) sowie starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit gegenüber externen und internen Stakeholdern. Nice-to-have: Praxiserfahrung bei der Einführung von IFRS in einer leitenden oder beratenden Funktion. Umfassende Anwendererfahrung mit LucaNet. Erfahrung mit SAP S4 Hana ist ein Plus. Erfahrung mit ABS-Strukturen  WHY FINN Shared Success (VSOP Finanzbeteiligung): Wir gewinnen gemeinsam. Über unser Virtual Stock Option Program  profitierst du direkt vom langfristigen Wertwachstum und dem Erfolg von FINN. Fuel your Growth (1.500€ Weiterbildungsbudget): Stillstand ist keine Option. Mit deinem jährlichen Development-Budget in Höhe von 1.500€ für Fortbildungen und Seminare entscheidest du selbst, wie du dich persönlich und professionell weiterentwickelst. Kenntnisse weiterer Cloud- und AI-Services sind von Vorteil. Praktische Erfahrung mit MLOps-Konzepten und entsprechenden Werkzeugen wie MLflow, Kubeflow oder Azure ML Pipelines. Erfahrung im Aufbau von RAG-Architekturen, Prompt Engineering und im Umgang mit Vektordatenbanken. Kenntnisse in der Integration und Orchestrierung von Sprachmodellen, idealerweise mit Frameworks wie LangChain oder LlamaIndex. Erfahrung mit CI/CD für ML-Anwendungen sowie sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse. Praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens zwei gängigen Machine-Learning-Frameworks, beispielsweise scikit-learn, PyTorch oder TensorFlow. Erfahrung im Aufbau von Enterprise-Architekturen in Cloud-Umgebungen. Kenntnisse in angrenzenden Bereichen wie Datenplattformen, Containerisierung, Container-Orchestrierung, Infrastructure as Code und Observability sind von Vorteil, beispielsweise mit Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Prometheus, Grafana oder Application Insights. Grundlegendes Verständnis von AI Governance, Responsible AI sowie Sicherheits- und Datenschutzanforderungen im Enterprise-Umfeld. Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit ML-/AI-Architekturen oder vergleichbaren technischen Aufgaben in Enterprise-Umgebungen. Erfahrung in einer technischen Leitungs- oder Architekturrolle ist wünschenswert. Azure-, AWS- oder Google-Cloud-Zertifizierungen sind ein Plus. Idealerweise Erfahrung in der Energiebranche oder Versorgungswirtschaft sowie mit datengetriebenen Anwendungsfällen. Mit über 70 Standorten in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz sowie mehr als 100 Mitarbeitenden gehören wir zu den führenden Anbietern im Bereich ästhetischer Dienstleistungen. Seit über 20 Jahren verbinden wir professionelle Beratung, innovative Behandlungskonzepte und echte Leidenschaft für Beauty. Unser Ziel ist es, Menschen zu einem neuen Hautgefühl zu verhelfen, sicher, individuell und mit höchstem Qualitätsanspruch. Bei hairfree erwarten dich klare Strukturen, moderne Prozesse, ein starkes Team und echte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere Interessentinnen und begleitest sie vom ersten Kontakt bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Dabei geht es nicht nur um Beratung, sondern darum, Vertrauen aufzubauen, Bedürfnisse zu erkennen und unsere Kundinnen für die passende Behandlungslösung zu begeistern. Das Beste: Du arbeitest ausschließlich mit Hot-Leads. Das bedeutet, du erhältst täglich vorqualifizierte Anfragen von Menschen, die bereits Interesse an dauerhafter Haarentfernung¹ haben. Du erkennst die Wünsche und Bedürfnisse unserer Interessent*innen und führst sie professionell bis zur verbindlichen Terminbuchung. Du fasst offene Kontakte zuverlässig nach und stellst sicher, dass kein potenzieller Kunde verloren geht. Du übernimmst die vertriebliche Verantwortung für deinen Standort und entwickelst ihn gemeinsam mit deinem Team erfolgreich weiter. Du behältst Umsatzziele, Vertriebskennzahlen und die Auslastung des Standorts jederzeit im Blick und leitest passende Maßnahmen ab. Du unterstützt deine Mitarbeitenden im Vertriebsalltag, gibst regelmäßig Feedback und förderst ihre fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung. Du sorgst dafür, dass vereinbarte Vertriebsstandards eingehalten und Kundenanfragen schnell sowie verbindlich bearbeitet werden. Du dokumentierst Gespräche, Termine und relevante Kundeninformationen sorgfältig in unserem digitalen System. jobs.description: THE JOB Reading this to the end is worth it. The Company: Why mute-labs? mute-labs is the EU market leader in acoustic phone booths, with more than 20,000 cabins sold and counting. We are self-funded, profitable since day one, and have no investors to answer to and no exit to chase. What we do have is a steep growth curve in revenue, a product made in Germany, and a genuine mission: giving the modern office some quiet back. We have built a strong direct and dealer business on the back of inbound demand and word of mouth. What we have not built yet is a real outbound engine for winning bigger accounts on purpose, from ambitious growth companies to household names like Volkswagen, adidas, IKEA, Red Bull, or Axel Springer, who already trust us today. That gap is this role, and how far into that world you grow is largely up to you. Outbound is not a new idea for us. We have piloted it in smaller pockets already, testing signal-based outreach and structured sequences with real results. What has been missing is someone to own this as a dedicated motion for bigger accounts rather than a side project squeezed in between other things. That is why we are building this out as a new department and you’d be joining a small, yet focussed team as one of the first hires. The Role: Build the Pipeline AND the Channel This is a founding position. You are not stepping into an existing sales org with a quota handed down from three reps before you. You are the first one in the building. What you build, and how you build it, is largely up to you and your team, and you can grow the size and ambition of your target accounts as you find your footing. Green Field, Full Ownership: Build your own pipeline from scratch. There is no inherited book of business and no recycled leads. The customer base you build is yours, and so is the revenue you generate from it. Your Stack, Your Sequences: Clay, Reply.io, LinkedIn Premium, and Aircall are all at your disposal. You design your own outreach sequences, run your own cold calling campaigns, and decide how the machine works. Nobody hands you a script. Segment Strategy, Together: You understand the market as well as anyone. Rather than being handed a target list from above, you and your manager will decide together which segments and account types are worth focusing on. Comp That Rewards More Than the First Deal: An uncapped bonus with a kicker for overperformance. Returning customers you bring in keep feeding your comp over time, not just the initial close. Landing an account well is worth more than landing it once. A Brand That Opens Doors: You are not cold-calling on behalf of an unknown startup. mute-labs is an established, well-regarded market leader with a reference list that already includes some of the biggest names in German and European business. That credibility is yours to use from day one. A seasoned team to back you up: Your manager has built and run outbound and enterprise sales hands-on, from cold pipeline to six-figure closes, and will work closely with you from day one, coaching, supporting, and training wherever it's actually needed rather than just checking in on numbers. Is This You? The Go-Getter: You do not wait to be told what to do next. You get on your feet quickly, figure out the shape of the problem, and start moving before anyone has to push you. Stakeholder Management: You know how to work a deal with more than one person in the room, decision-makers, influencers, and budget holders, and you can keep several of those relationships moving in parallel without losing the thread. jobs.title: Research Scientist - 3D Reconstruction & Novel View Synthesis
jobs.description: SpAItial is pioneering the next generation of World Models, pushing the boundaries of generative AI, computer vision, and the simulation of reality. You should have command of the latest scene representations, such as Gaussian splats and radiance fields, and of reconstruction methods across the full range, from per-scene optimization to feed-forward models. We are looking for someone who knows the field well enough to choose the right representation and method for a problem, and then improve on it. This is a senior, hands-on research role for someone who has already done reconstruction research across more than one representation. Responsibilities Advance the state of the art in 3D reconstruction, from research ideas to working methods. Work across the full range of reconstruction problems (geometry, appearance, materials, lighting and dynamics, from sparse or incomplete observations), and novel view synthesis, including neural rendering and feed-forward view generators. Design losses, priors, and optimization strategies that improve fidelity, robustness, and efficiency. Build rigorous evaluations on public and internal benchmarks, and use them to drive decisions. Collaborate with research and engineering colleagues to bring successful methods into production systems. Key qualifications PhD in computer vision, graphics, or a related field; publications at top venues (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, SIGGRAPH, NeurIPS). Deep, hands-on knowledge of modern scene representations, for example Gaussian splats and radiance fields, and the ability to weigh their trade-offs. Research experience across the reconstruction spectrum, from per-scene optimization to feed-forward models. Deep understanding of multi-view geometry, camera models, and rendering. Strong experience with deep learning frameworks. At SpAItial, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description: <p>SingleStore is looking for an accomplished sales professional to join our Sales Team. AI is moving from experimentation into production, and this role is an opportunity to break into AI while doing meaningful enterprise selling.</p> <p>As an Account Executive, AI Hunter, your job is simple: create new SingleStore customers. You will find companies building AI applications where data access, real-time context, memory, retrieval, or operational scale is becoming a constraint—and turn those challenges into new SingleStore customers. You will own a broad territory, build a majority self-sourced pipeline, create demand in an emerging category, and close greenfield enterprise opportunities.</p> <p>This is a true hunting role. You will engage customers before they have a defined project, develop customer-specific points of view, create urgency around business and technical problems, work with technical experts to land first production workloads, and build a measurable new-logo business with broad ownership. The ideal candidate is a measurable enterprise hunter who is competitive, curious, technically credible, resilient, and able to sell business outcomes. Direct AI sales experience is valuable, but proven selling ability and technical curiosity matter more than a narrow “AI seller” title.</p> <h2>Role and Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Build and execute a territory strategy for net-new customer acquisition.</li> <li>Prospect fearlessly across a broad account universe using proactive, persistent outbound, account-based, partner, and market-education motions; stay resilient and effective through rejection and ambiguity.</li> <li>Form account hypotheses, map the buying center, and earn first meetings with relevant points of view tailored to the customer.</li> <li>Engage executive, business, technical, security, and procurement stakeholders.</li> <li>Lead great business-first discovery, connect AI and data challenges to fundable goals, and build quantified ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases.</li> <li>Build and develop champions, multi-thread the buying group, earn executive and economic-buyer access, and maintain stakeholder alignment; own the stakeholder plan, mutual action plan, close plan, value case, stage gates, forecast, and commercial outcome.</li> <li>Lead complex sales cycles through technical validation, security, legal, procurement, negotiation, and close.</li> <li>Partner with Solutions and Forward Deployment Engineers and cross-functional teams to validate technical fit and establish the first production workload.</li> <li>Navigate competitive displacement and maintain disciplined activity management, CRM hygiene, reporting, qualification, forecasting, and opportunity management; showcase clear metrics such as pipeline created, meetings, conversion, quota attainment, and new-logo performance.</li> <li>Be AI fluent: use AI and research tools productively and responsibly while applying judgment, validating outputs, and separating facts from hypotheses.</li> <li>Travel within the assigned territory as required.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2>Required Skills and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of quota-carrying B2B enterprise software sales experience, ideally selling to large or technically sophisticated organizations; experience in data, cloud, analytics, AI, or adjacent technical domains is a plus.</li> <li>Repeated, quantified quota success with clear ownership of new-logo wins and self-sourced pipeline.</li> <li>Experience closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving executives, technical evaluators, security, legal, finance, procurement, and partners.</li> <li>Ability to sell measurable business outcomes and build ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases.</li> &lt

jobs.description: About Zip Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before. The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA. Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups. Your Role You'll be a force multiplier for the Pre-sales organization. You'll own how Zip demos end to end: the environments, data, scripts, and certification standards that let any Solution Engineer deliver a technically credible demo quickly and consistently. You will be responsible for developing the solution demo frameworks, reusable assets, and self-service approach that every Solution Engineer and Account Executive benefits from. You’ll work closely with Solution Engineering leadership, Enterprise Architecture, Product, and Product Marketing to design our demos of the future. This is a hands-on builder role, not a maintenance seat. You're building the systems and vision for what a great demo looks like at Zip. What You'll Do Own demo environment build and operations: Design, build, and maintain the demo environments, data sets, demo pathways, and demo scripts every SEs uses. Build self-service tooling and templates: Turn demo-builds into packages assets that SEs and AEs can pull directly. Shape our demo narratives and storytelling: Develop the talk tracks, narrative arcs, and messaging that turn technical features into a story every SE can tell. Keep demo assets in lockstep with releases: Partner with Product and Product Marketing so new agents, integrations, and vertical use cases ship with a working demo environment and script. Automate scripting and asset generation with AI: Use LLMs and AI coding tools to generate and maintain demo scripts, synthetic data, and environment scaffolding, cutting manual build time on every new demo asset. Automate end-to-end demo workflows with Playwright: Script and maintain Playwright-based flows that walk through full demo scenarios automatically, so environments get validated and refreshed without manual QA. Build with AI-native development tools: Prototype and ship internal tooling using tools like Replit and Lovable, taking new demo assets from idea to working build. Build and maintain agentic loops: Design agent workflows that can prepare, validate, and repair demo environments on their own, catching broken flows before an SE does. Qualifications 2–5+ years in technical pre-sales, sales engineering, or demo engineering at a high-growth B2B SaaS company. Real hands-on build skills: scripting fluency (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar), comfort with REST APIs and webhooks, and enough cloud/infrastructure familiarity (AWS, GCP, or Azure) to stand up and operate a demo environment without waiting on engineering. Hands-on experience using AI to automate scripting and asset generation Experience automating end-to-end workflows with Playwright or a comparable browser-automation framework, for demo environment validation, regression testing, or scripted walkthroughs. Direct experience building with AI-native development tools such as Replit, Lovable, or similar. Comfortable going from a blank canvas to a working prototype largely through AI-assisted building. jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We’re looking for a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Experience team at Pleo. In this role, you’ll own a portfolio of large, complex, and strategically important enterprise customers, helping them achieve measurable business outcomes, expand adoption, manage change, and build long-term value with Pleo. You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders while coordinating the broader Pleo relationship across Customer Success, Product, Support, Sales, Finance, and other internal teams. This is not a reactive account-management role. You’ll be expected to understand each customer’s business priorities, operating model, success criteria, and risk profile. You’ll turn that understanding into clear success plans, executive engagement strategies, adoption programs, renewal plans, and growth opportunities. The right candidate will bring at least three years of direct experience managing enterprise customers , along with the communication skills, commercial judgment, and operational discipline required to manage high-value relationships in a fast-paced technology environment. Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to our Manager of Customer Success, Large & High-Growth Customers and work closely with teams across: Customer Support Customer Onboarding Sales and Account Management Product and Product Operations Revenue Operations Finance Data and Analytics Program Management and Operations You’ll work with customer stakeholders across finance, procurement, operations, technology, transformation, and executive leadership. You’ll be responsible for creating alignment across these stakeholders, establishing clear governance, and ensuring Pleo remains connected to the customer’s evolving strategic and operational priorities. What you’ll be doing As a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager , you will: Own a portfolio of enterprise customers with accountability for customer health, value realisation, adoption, retention, renewal readiness, advocacy, and growth. Build trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders , positioning yourself as a credible advisor who understands their business priorities and operating environment. Develop detailed customer success plans that connect the customer’s strategic goals to measurable outcomes, adoption milestones, responsibilities, and timelines. Lead executive business reviews and strategic customer meetings that demonstrate value, address risks, align stakeholders, and create clear next steps. Drive product adoption across complex customer organisations , helping customers expand usage across teams, entities, locations, use cases, and workflows. Create and maintain detailed stakeholder maps , identifying decision-makers, champions, influencers, operational contacts,

jobs.description: Elevate the Future of Global Content with TransPerfect AI TransPerfect is the leading solution provider of AI, Technology, and Data solutions; we are the engine behind the global AI revolution. As we continue to redefine how the world’s largest enterprises process, train, and deploy data, we are seeking a high-caliber AI Sales Representative to join our elite Business Development team. This is a hunter role designed for a sophisticated sales professional who thrives at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and global enterprise strategy. You will be responsible for identifying, prospecting, and closing new business opportunities, selling our comprehensive suite of AI data solutions—including data collection, annotation, and generative AI services—to Fortune 500 leaders. TransPerfect AI offers a premier product suite that addresses the most critical bottlenecks in the AI lifecycle, from LLM fine-tuning to high-stakes data security. We are in a hyper-growth phase. You will have a seat at the table in shaping our market approach and the opportunity to drive massive revenue in the industry's most relevant sector. The Ideal Candidate You are a strategic closer with a minimum of 6+ years of enterprise sales experience, specifically within the AI, Machine Learning, or Data Services landscape. You don’t just sell "services"—you sell a vision of digital transformation. You possess the technical gravitas to speak with Chief Data Officers and AI Researchers, and the commercial acumen to navigate complex procurement cycles at the highest levels. Key position responsibilities: Drive New Revenue: Systematically identify and close high-value accounts, exceeding annual sales targets and expanding TransPerfect’s AI footprint. Consultative Leadership: Act as a subject matter expert, guiding clients through the complexities of AI data preparation and the implementation of bespoke AI workflows. Strategic Prospecting: Build and maintain a robust pipeline of enterprise-level opportunities through aggressive networking and sophisticated outbound strategies. Collaborate for Success: Partner with our world-class Solutions Architects and Project Managers to ensure the seamless transition from "Closed-Won" to high-quality delivery. Essential skills required: Commit to a high level of integrity and service Deliver quality work Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations Owning your performance and taking responsibility Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients and co-workers Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems Required Experience: Industry Expertise: 6+ years of proven success in enterprise-level sales, with a deep understanding of the AI/ML ecosystem. The Closer Mentality: A documented track record of meeting and exceeding seven-figure quotas. Strategic Communication: Ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership. Entrepreneurial Drive: A self-starter who excels in an autonomous environment and possesses the grit required to win in a competitive market. TransPerfect values equal opportunities. Applicants are therefore considered regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnic origin, skin colour, religion, belief, descent, genes, disabilities, sexual orientation, marital status or other characteristics worthy of protection. Applicants with disabilities are welcome and encouraged. jobs.description: Your mission You train the technical teams of strategic cloud partners to build, integrate and support AI applications with confidence. Your audience is solution architects, field engineers, developers, technical consultants and sales engineering teams. You take a proven AI curriculum and make it work for cloud partner audiences: real deployment scenarios, partner-specific examples, live troubleshooting. You are the technical face of our client in the room. Your tasks include: Deliver instructor-led bootcamps, technical workshops, train-the-trainer sessions and hands-on labs for cloud partner organisations. Adapt core AI training content for partner audiences such as solution architects, field engineers, developers and partner enablement leaders. Translate AI capabilities into practical cloud scenarios, reference architectures and customer-facing use cases. Lead practical exercises on how to build, integrate, deploy, evaluate and support AI applications in cloud environments. Troubleshoot participant issues live, from lab setup and API calls to code samples and implementation questions. Work with program leadership and partner enablement stakeholders to refine delivery plans and localise examples. Keep delivery quality high across regions, cohorts and groups with different technical maturity. Capture recurring knowledge gaps and recommend improvements to content, labs and facilitation guides. Your profile You move comfortably between developer-level detail, cloud architecture context and an executive-friendly explanation. You are energised by teaching complex material and you earn credibility with engineers by knowing your stuff. Experience & Education More than 5 years of professional experience in technical training, developer education, solution architecture, technical consulting, partner engineering, software development or cloud enablement. Experience delivering technical workshops, bootcamps, labs or train-the-trainer sessions for professional audiences. Strong practical fluency with generative AI, LLM concepts, prompt engineering, APIs, SDKs and modern AI application patterns. Hands-on familiarity with cloud platforms and partner environments such as AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure or Oracle Cloud. Fluent English; a second language (French, Spanish or German) is a strong plus. Located in or near a major EMEA city with an airport (for example London). Willingness to travel for partner workshops and regional programs (approx. 25-35%). Of advantage: familiarity with Amazon Bedrock (AWS Bedrock). Of advantage: experience enabling cloud partners, hyperscalers, systems integrators or partner field organisations. Of advantage: experience building hands-on labs, certification pathways or partner academies. jobs.title: Director of Partnerships and Technology Alliances
jobs.description: About DataCamp Data and AI skills are critical for thriving today, and DataCamp is the platform that empowers everyone to learn them. We help individuals and Fortune 1000 companies close the data and AI skills gap through world-class learning, hands-on training, and a global community of expert instructors. In this role, you'll build the partnerships function that scales our curriculum—bringing the world's leading content providers, technology vendors, and highest-profile instructors onto DataCamp so millions of learners can build the skills that matter. About the role This is a player-coach role that reports to our Content organization. You will own the partnership strategy end-to-end, personally close the deals that define it, and then build a small team behind you as the function grows. Here's what your day-to-day will look like: Own DataCamp's partnership strategy for curriculum: which content providers, technology vendors, and marquee experts we partner with, in what order, and why. Source, negotiate, and close partnerships—licensed and co-branded content, official vendor certifications, and marquee instructor deals. Build and manage senior relationships across the AI, data, and cloud ecosystem, from partner leadership through to their content and product teams. Work with curriculum, product, legal, and marketing to take partnerships from signed agreement to live content that learners actually complete. Define what a high-quality partner looks like for DataCamp and hold the bar—prioritizing depth and learner impact over volume of logos. jobs.description: At Sanity.io , we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like SKIMS , Figma , Riot Games , Anthropic , COMPLEX , Nordstrom , and Morningbrew are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations. We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Billing & Integrations, the team behind usage metering, plans and subscriptions, spend controls, invoices, and selected partner integrations. Your team makes it possible for us to launch billable capabilities and to run routine billing through reliable APIs and tools. You’ll also keep our integrations dependable and current. Leading a team at Sanity means owning strategy, roadmap, and execution alongside your product partner. This is a player-coach role: most of your time will go to people, priorities, and delivery, while you stay close enough to the code to review designs, unblock difficult problems, and guide technical decisions. What you will do: Lead delivery of a reliable monetization platform Own the engineering roadmap with Product, balancing new billing capabilities, customer-facing improvements, reliability, and reducing manual work. Guide the usage-to-invoice architecture: metering correctness, subscription lifecycle, reconciliation, and dependable budget and limit enforcement. Turn recurring plan, coupon, credit, and invoicing requests into documented APIs and self-service tools that other teams can operate independently. Coach and develop the engineering team Develop engineers through clear feedback, meaningful ownership, career support, and hiring as the team’s needs evolve. Stay technically engaged through architecture reviews, pairing, and code where it helps the team most; strengthen testing, observability, incident response, and safe migration practices. You have proven experience managing engineers and delivering software at a product or SaaS company, backed by a substantial hands-on engineering background. You’ve led backend or platform systems where correctness and reliability matter. Experience in billing, payments, usage metering, subscriptions, or entitlements is especially useful. You turn ambiguity into clear priorities, deliver incrementally, and can show how your team’s work improved customer or business outcomes. You care about growing people and building a team with shared ownership. You work effectively across functions and timezones, and replace recurring manual work with reusable capabilities. jobs.title: Graduate Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: TL;DR: Our graduate roles are about who we believe you can become, not your previous experiences and qualifications. Everyone has to take the first step somewhere and we’re excited about creating this environment. You'll walk into some of the world's most complex enterprise systems and deploy Conduct against the challenges our customers face. You build the kind of trust that turns an initial pilot into a long-term partnership - and the product insights you bring back will directly shape what we build next. Why Conduct We believe the world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the decade-old systems they run on. Today they don't. Every process change, every new product line runs into SAP systems layered with decades of custom code and complexity no human mind can fully comprehend. New requirements take months to ship, system migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain. We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed and ambition. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service. We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out. What you'll own You will make sure Conduct lands and sticks. You join strategic accounts early, run the technical deployment hands-on, and fully take over post-sale. No two days look the same: you fly out to customers when it counts, you onboard hundreds of end users, surface expansion signals, and eventually turn a single entry point into a multi-year partnership. Most importantly, you will have a direct line into product and shape Conduct’s product roadmap as we further build out the platform. This is a very entrepreneurial role, our GTM team is still small and lean. You'll build the engine behind everything: onboarding flows, tooling, reusable playbooks — enough that customer capacity compounds without headcount scaling linearly. Who we hire We're looking for sharp, driven, high potential graduates who share our obsession with understanding how software works. You'll fit right in if your peers describe you are one of the sharpest people they have met, you’re hungry to work at pace and at your best in an environment which intersects technical and commercial enterprise. In practice that tends to look like: Recent graduate with a strong academic background. Exceptional communication skills . You can build positive and strong relationships from CIO’s to professors and peers. Entrepreneurial instinct. You spot expansion, you can hold an early commercial conversation, and you understand that a great deployment is also how accounts grow. A builder with genuine hunger. You want to build the process and do the hands-on customer work, not just one or the other. Low ego and self-aware. You're comfortable saying "I don't know" in a technically complex environment, then going and figuring it out. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger. At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries. The team: You're joining as we reshape the People & Operations Experience team, which brings together ops, payroll, people tech, engagement and internal comms. That makes this a build-and-run role. You'll run payroll from day one and help design how the function works going forward, from processes to tooling to documentation. The role You'll take ownership of French payroll, starting with a proper handover from the colleague who runs it today and building towards running it independently. Alongside it, you'll look after the employee lifecycle: joiners, leavers and everything in between. It's real responsibility, with a team around you. Your development goes in two directions: continuous improvement of how People Ops works, and a progressive move into Global Payroll (US, UK, Singapore) as your confidence and scope grow. Your arrival also creates room for the whole team to take on bigger things, and that includes you. What you'll do Own French payroll Run the full monthly cycle: data collection, absences and leave, inputs, controls, validation and payslip checks Prepare and submit statutory filings on time (URSSAF, DSN, IJSS/Net-entreprise and other mandatory declarations) Manage variable pay and contractual changes, and build the VPI file for ADP Decidium Work with Finance on transfer files, cost reporting, headcount tracking and variance analysis Handle day to day equity payroll declarations (stock options / BSPCE) as you slowly build your expertise Manage benefits, meal vouchers and provider relationships Track regulatory changes and turn them into better processes Run the employee lifecycle Handle joiners and leavers: contracts, health insurance and transport registration, visa and absence data Keep Workday data accurate and compliant Help document and improve the processes being rebuilt, and contribute to cross-functional People projects You'll work with Finance, Talent Acquisition, HRBPs, C&B and our provider ADP. What you bring 2–3 years of French payroll experience, with hands-on exposure to the monthly cycle and a readiness to own it Solid knowledge of French social legislation (URSSAF, DSN) and experience with a payroll tool (ADP or similar) Rigour: you close the month on time, without being chased A builder's instinct: you document as you go and like making things work better Comfort working in English in a multicultural team Curiosity about international payroll and a real appetite to widen your scope At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits

The AI Ops team drives this transformation: it builds and operates AI agents, applications, and the associated tooling, in production. We bring impact at high speed. We're looking for a Tech Lead to set the technical direction of AI Ops and lead the engineers who build it. You'll own the architecture of our agent platform and raise the bar on how we ship, while staying hands-on in the code. This is not a research-oriented role: we're looking for a builder with experience making systems work in production. Why join us ? A rare, AI-native playground: make a profitable scale-up's operations AI-native, with agents in production and visible weekly impact, backed by best-in-class tools (Claude, internal agentic tooling, dedicated observability) and an AI-assisted engineering culture. A fast paced organisation able to redefine itself quicker than any other Real autonomy: define problems with business teams, own solutions through to production. Your Impact at Brevo: Design, build, and operate AI agents in production. Integrate internal data to build relevant context accurately and in a controlled way (context engineering). Discover needs directly with business teams (CX, RevOps, Data), hand agents over in forward-deployed-engineer mode, and contribute to the architectural vision of the agent platform. Own the architecture of the solutions we build, and make the key technical decisions (multi-agent design, pre-processing, deterministic routing, LLM-as-judge, observability, human in the loop surface of interaction) Own deployment and operations: CI/CD, sandbox/production environments, monitoring, and agent observability. Set engineering standards for code quality, code review, evals, testing, and deployment. Make sure the team follows them. Whole-system thinker: you challenge architecture decisions and weigh the business impact of technical choices. Comfortable with ambiguity: you turn a fuzzy problem into a shipped solution without a pre-written spec, and help your team do the same. DevOps-fluent: end-to-end deployment, infra-as-code, and debugging network environments (VPN, proxies). Agents & LLMs: hands-on experience shipping agents to production (ADK, LangChain, or similar), including applied prompt engineering and evaluation. Its AI Data Infrastructure platform reduces operational burden through AI-powered autonomous operations while aligning the right storage media, performance, and protection to each workload through human-approved lifecycle policies.   Built on CORE5 cyber resilience and open-code principles, Scality software delivers extreme performance, operational simplicity, and sustainable economics.    The world's most demanding enterprises and government organizations depend on Scality to power AI initiatives, defend critical data, and build infrastructure that lasts for decades. jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ?    Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. jobs.title: Head of Formal Verification (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Your mission You own the direction of our formal verification business. Our managers keep delivery predictable. You decide what the organisation becomes. You report to the CEO and are a member of the executive leadership team. You carry the FV consulting business as a whole — where it goes, how it performs, who leads it — and you answer for it. You will not solve verification problems, and you will rarely run a project or an account yourself. Concretely, you own: Direction . The roadmap for FV consulting. Which capabilities, markets and problem domains we pursue, and what we decline. Customers. You are the face of LUBIS EDA to our key accounts and at executive level. You open the doors your managers cannot, and you carry the conversations that decide a long-term relationship. Organisation . Structure, standards, playbooks, talent pipelines, and the career framework in practice. You keep improving how we work, and you decide when a new technology — AI among them — changes the way we deliver. Leaders . Our Verification Managers report to you. You hire them, develop them, and grow the bench behind them. This is the main measure of the role. Quality . Holding the quality bar under commercial pressure. Our entire positioning depends on it. Product interface . What our engineers learn on customer projects is the best input our software roadmap gets. Your profile You have developed leaders, not "only" engineers. You have set direction where there was no precedent, made the calls, and carried an organisation with you. You build systems that outlast your attention. You need credibility in formal verification. Not to overrule your senior engineers. You need it to make the calls only you can make: is a capability gap real, is a quality standard achievable at the price we quote, does a bet on a new formal domain hold. YOUR EXPERIENCE 12+ years in semiconductor verification, EDA or adjacent engineering services. 5+ years in leadership, including managers reporting to you. Fluent in formal methods and their trade-offs. Credible with a customer’s engineering leadership and on a conference stage. You know how technical services are priced and defended on quality rather than volume. Nice-to-have: you have scaled a technical organisation past start-up stage, where the systems had to be built. Why us? LUBIS is growing, and we’re looking for a Head of Formal Verification. This is one of those roles where you don’t just join an organisation. You help build it. Our formal sign-off business is growing. Our customers are getting bigger. So are our ambitions. We’re looking for someone who wants real ownership of what comes next: how we develop our people, how we deliver outstanding projects, how we work with our customers, and what world-class technical consulting at LUBIS should look like. You’ll work directly with our leadership team. You’ll have the freedom to shape structures and standards. You’ll build an organisation around some of the strongest formal verification expertise in the market. We’re not looking for someone to maintain what already exists. We’re looking for someone who gets excited about making it better, bigger and more professional. If you want a leadership role with real influence, and the chance to build something you’ll be proud of, come build it with us. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace. Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence. Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines. At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth. How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here. We are looking for an engaged and passionate Staff Engineer to join our growing engineering department and be a technical leader across our engineering teams.   As a Staff Engineer , you will be responsible for driving influence across teams and domains, leading solution delivery on cross-functional and strategic initiatives, and serving as a technical leader within the engineering organization. You will ensure the set quality standards and drive the adoption of best practices in architecture, security, and DevOps.   Quality, excellence, and agility drive our delivery processes and you will help us level these up. jobs.description: About Quandela: Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions Our ambition is to build large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation.  Getting there will require several generations of intermediate architectures. Choosing the right ones means understanding what can be built, what these systems can compute and how efficiently they can do so. About this position: You will join Quandela’s Quantum Information team within Architecture , working on the evaluation and design of our near- and mid-term quantum architectures.  Your role will sit between quantum theory, computational capability and real hardware constraints . You will develop methods to evaluate architecture concepts, understand their performance and limitations, and help guide future architecture choices. Depending on your background, you may draw on complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, benchmarking or related areas . You will work closely with our Device Physics, FTQC and Q.Algorithms Team. jobs.title: Product Manager, Healthcare (H/F)
jobs.description: Withings est une entreprise française pionnière de la santé connectée. Depuis 2008, nous concevons des produits et services qui permettent à chacun de mieux comprendre sa santé et aux professionnels de santé de mieux accompagner leurs patients. Balances connectées, montres, tensiomètres, dispositifs médicaux et services digitaux : nos technologies sont aujourd’hui utilisées par des millions de personnes et s’intègrent de plus en plus au parcours de soin. Nous cherchons aujourd’hui un(e) Product Manager Healthcare pour contribuer au développement de nos produits et services de santé, notamment autour du Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), du suivi des maladies chroniques et de nouveaux parcours de soin digitaux. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Who we are Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce. Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants. For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible. Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel. We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label. Today, Lemrock is already: 100M+ conversations per month 150+ brand clients a $100B market structuring at high speed Context You'll join a tight-knit team with high product standards and direct access to production deployment : our models are tested in real-world conditions, with several million users each month, with very short cycles between prototyping, integration and deployment. In this context, you'll work on the next generation of agentic and recommendation systems : building the pipelines, agents, and models that sit at the core of our product. Your Mission Your goal is to build and scale the agentic infrastructure that powers Lemrock's commerce intelligence : turning raw signals into automated, self-improving systems at production scale. Concretely, you will: Analyze large-scale conversational interaction datasets (100M+ events/month) to uncover behavioral patterns, intent signals, and performance drivers. Design and deploy agentic pipelines end-to-end , from data ingestion and enrichment to model orchestration, monitoring, and continuous improvement, integrated into systems exposed to millions of requests daily. Build autonomous agents that keep our knowledge infrastructure accurate and current. Translate insights into iteration loops in production , by updating, fine-tuning, and improving our existing recommendation and ranking algorithms with tight constraints on latency, robustness, and business outcomes. jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer | Kimchi (LLM Inference Optimization)
jobs.description: <h4>Why Cast AI?</h4> <p>Cast AI is an automation platform that operates cloud-native and AI infrastructure at scale. By embedding autonomous decision-making directly into Kubernetes and cloud environments, Cast AI continuously optimizes performance, reliability, and efficiency in production.<br>The old way doesn't work. As Kubernetes and AI environments grow, manual decisions don’t. Cast AI replaces tickets, alerts, and manual tuning with continuous automation that adapts infrastructure as conditions change. Efficiency and cost savings follow naturally from that automation.<br>Over 2,100 companies already rely on Cast AI, including Akamai, BMW, Cisco, FICO, HuggingFace, NielsenIQ, Swisscom, and TGS.<br><br><strong>Global team, diverse perspectives</strong></p> <p>We're headquartered in Miami, but our impact is international. We take a global and intentional approach to diversity. Today, Cast AI operates across 34 countries spanning Europe, North America, Latin America, and APAC, bringing a wide range of perspectives into how we build and lead.<br><br><strong>Unicorn momentum</strong></p> <p>In January 2026, we achieved unicorn status with a strategic investment from Pacific Alliance Ventures, the corporate venture arm of Shinsegae Group (a $50+ billion Korean conglomerate). Our valuation now exceeds $1 billion, and we're just getting started.</p> <p><strong>Join us as we build the future of autonomous infrastructure.</strong></p> <h4>About the role</h4> <p>Throughput. Latency. KV cache utilization.</p> <p>Move those three numbers in the right direction, and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That's the entire thesis of this role. Every kernel you tune, every quantization scheme you ship, every scheduler tweak you land shows up directly in a customer's p99 and on our P&amp;L.<br>This is a high-impact seat. It is also a high-autonomy seat as you'll be given the room to lead the technical direction of inference optimization at Kimchi, not execute someone else's roadmap.</p> <p><strong>The problem: </strong>running LLMs in production is a moving target. The "right" model and serving configuration for a workload depend on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth,&nbsp;quantization tolerance, and a dozen other variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a model once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost.&nbsp;Kimchi is the system that makes that decision automatically - continuously matching workloads to the most cost-efficient, best-performing LLM and serving configuration on a customer's infrastructure. We're&nbsp;building the optimization layer between the model and the hardware, and we need engineers who understand both sides deeply.</p> <p><strong>Stack</strong></p> <p>Python; vLLM; SGLang; TensorRT-LLM; PyTorch; CUDA-adjacent tooling; Kubernetes; gRP; ClickHouse; PostgreSQL; GCP Pub/Sub; AWS / GCP / Azure; GitLab CI; ArgoCD; Prometheus; Grafana; Loki; Tempo.</p> <h4>Requirements:</h4> <ul> <li>5+ years building real ML systems, with a portfolio that shows depth in inference or training infrastructure (not just model training notebooks).</li> <li>Strong Python - production services, not scripts.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with at least one of vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM, and a working mental model of why an inference engine performs the way it does on a given GPU.</li> <li>Fluency with quantization tradeoffs - you've measured quality regressions, not just compression ratios.</li> <li>Comfort with distributed systems: collective communication, sharding s

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Paris
jobs.description: About H: When we released Holo4 on 28 September, we published every trajectory behind its public benchmark scores at trajectories.hcompany.ai . For OSWorld that's 369 desktop tasks, each run 3 times, with the steps, tokens and time of every attempt. This role builds and runs the evaluation framework that produces runs like these. H builds computer-use agents and the models behind them. Developers use them through a managed API , and our forward deployed engineers take them into enterprise workflows. What this team owns The evaluation framework: orchestration, runtimes and observability. Researchers and forward deployed engineers bring the benchmarks, across web apps, desktop applications and the command line. Your job is to make the framework that runs them reliable, fast and cheap, and to make adding a new one quick. Research uses the results to choose checkpoints and decide whether a model ships. Product and the forward deployed engineers use them to measure agents on customer workflows. It carries roughly 50 benchmarks now. That number should be between 100 and 200 soon, and the framework has to keep up. What you'd be doing Integration support for researchers and forward deployed engineers bringing in a benchmark, with a shorter path each time. Setting the standard for how a benchmark enters the framework, and building the checks that enforce it. Scheduling and observability, so cluster capacity isn't left idle while evaluation jobs queue. Reproducible results across trials, so a release decision rests on numbers that hold. Whatever stack a benchmark calls for. One week that's cluster tuning; the next it's a browser extension or desktop environments. Time with customers, from single developers to large companies, to find out what they want measured, then automating it so the results flow back into our harnesses and models. The first few months By 3 months you'll have helped researchers or forward deployed engineers integrate 5 benchmarks, and started fixing what slows the framework down. By 6 months one part of it is yours, for example scaling the runs, observability, or a group of related benchmarks, and a release will have gone out on your numbers. By 12 months you'll know the design and trade-offs of the whole evaluation system, and be the person the rest of H asks about evaluations. Who you'd work with Ceiran Chapman, our VP Engineering, is hiring for this role. You'd join the evaluation team. The people relying on your work day to day are H's researchers and forward deployed engineers. What we think it takes Likely a good fit if you Have spent 5+ years in backend development, with production Python at the core, and use coding agents to go faster without letting quality drop. Have built test, QA or evaluation tooling that other teams depended on, and care whether a number is right. Have operated distributed systems on Kubernetes in a public cloud. AWS experience helps most. Have built and shipped systems end to end, including APIs (REST or GraphQL) and integrations with outside services. Know relational and non-relational databases, and message queues such as SQS, RabbitMQ or Kafka. Instrument what you build, with metrics, tracing and monitoring from the start. Stronger still if you have Measured LLM quality before, or built agents yourself. Packaged and run workloads in Docker and on virtual machines. Used Temporal, Dask, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Grafana or Datadog. Automated web or desktop software with Playwright, Selenium or a browser extension you wrote. Set standards other engineers follow, through code review, design review or mentoring. You do not need a background in machine learning. We'll work that out with you. If you match most of this but not all of it, apply anyway. How we hire A 30 minute call with our Talent team, a 60 minute technical challenge, a 60 minute system design interview, and a 30 minute final conversation with Ceiran. About 3.5 hours in total. jobs.description: Why work at Higgsfield AI? jobs.description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. The Role You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers. What You'll Work On Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds. Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare. World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains. Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships. Who We're Looking For A research scientist who has led work on world models, self-supervised learning or probabilistic spatio-temporal modelling, and who wants to see it run on real sites. The Role You will own the path a code change takes from commit to robot, and the evidence behind every gate on that path. Today the honest answer to "is this build safe?" is "it worked on the test robot." You will replace that with a system: the simulation environment the team tests against, the regression suites that run on every change, the hardware-in-the-loop rigs, and the release gates that decide whether a build can go onto a robot that will patrol a customer site alone tonight. This is the first engineer dedicated to reliability and test infrastructure, and it sits in our Robot Autonomy team, next to the engineers building perception, localisation, planning and locomotion. Our robots patrol security sites, critical infrastructure and defence facilities without a human present, so a bad release is not a rollback: it is a customer incident. Within six months, nothing should reach a customer robot without passing something you built. What You'll Work On Release pipeline: code change, automated tests, simulation at scale, staging robot, pilot site, full rollout, with explicit pass criteria at every gate and nothing advancing without meeting them. Simulation as infrastructure: a GPU-backed simulation environment (Isaac Sim today) running continuously, so engineers test against scenarios instead of queueing for the one robot in the lab. Scenario libraries and regression suites: coverage across the whole on-robot stack, perception through locomotion, and the infrastructure to run thousands of scenarios on every change. Hardware-in-the-loop: bench rigs and test procedures on the physical robots for what simulation cannot tell you. Failure injection: drop sensors, degrade LiDAR returns, kill the network link, corrupt odometry, then verify the system degrades and recovers the way we tell customers it does. Field incidents to tests: when a robot misbehaves on site, reproduce it deterministically and turn it into a permanent regression test. Acceptance criteria: turn product and customer requirements into measurable tests, and report against them without softening the numbers. Who We're Looking For A test, validation or reliability engineer who has shipped a product where failure had consequences, and who has seen what changes when a fleet goes from one unit to fifty. Your Background 4+ years in test, validation, reliability, SRE or platform engineering on a product that shipped to customers. jobs.title: Brand Manager
jobs.description: About Flink Flink Robotics delivers superhuman physical work. We are a Zürich-based deep tech startup developing a physics-based world model that lets machines reason about the physical world and do work robots couldn't do before - starting with logistics. We're a team of engineers and researchers with roots at ETH Zürich, backed by leading European investors. The technology is ambitious; now we want the way we look and show up to match it. The role You make Flink look as cool from the outside as it is on the inside. As our first brand & marketing hire, you own how Flink shows up to the world and help shape how it feels to work here. This is a hands-on role with a lot of ownership from day one. You'll work directly with the CEO and the whole team, and you'll have real freedom to set the tone. We care more about taste, energy and drive than years of experience; junior profiles are very welcome. What you'll do Own our look and feel. Evolve and guard Flink's visual identity. Logo use, colours, typography, photo and video style: and make sure everything we put out is consistent. Run our website. Keep flink.so fresh, fast and on-message: new pages, news, job posts, visuals. Work with freelancers or agencies where needed. Build our social presence. Plan and create content for LinkedIn and other channels. Robot footage, behind-the-scenes, team stories, milestones and grow an audience that gets excited about what we do. Run marketing campaigns. Turn our story into campaigns, from product launches and trade fair pushes to customer and recruiting campaigns. You own the creative and the message, and work closely with the Growth team on goals, audiences and channels. Tell our story visually. Create or coordinate photos, videos, graphics and animations of our robots and technology. Support pitch decks, investor updates and sales materials so they look world-class. Organise events. From trade fairs and demo days to meetups, customer visits and team events. Plan them, run them and make them memorable. Make our space amazing. Shape how our office and workshop look and feel, so every visitor - investor, customer or candidate - gets the Flink vibe. Strengthen our employer brand. Help us attract top engineers: careers page, job ads, recruiting content, how candidates experience Flink. Bring the brand inside. Help build team culture through internal communication, onboarding touches, swag; you name it. What you bring A strong eye for design and visuals: you know what looks great. Creativity and ideas of your own: you don't wait for a brief to start making things Hands-on skills in design tools (e.g. Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva) and comfort creating content for social media A portfolio that shows your taste: professional, freelance, student or side projects all count Organisational talent: you can juggle an event, a website update and a video shoot in the same week Excellent written and spoken English Curiosity about technology and robotics: you don't need to be an engineer, but you want to understand what we build First experience in branding, marketing, design or communications (internships count) Nice to have German (spoken or written) Photo or video shooting and editing skills Experience with website design Interior design, set design or event production experience Previous startup or tech-company experience What we offer The chance to build a brand from the ground up at a deep tech startup on the rise Real ownership and direct access to the founders: your work is visible from day one Robots, a workshop and a story worth telling: some of the most exciting content in tech, waiting to be shown to the world A growing, ambitious team in Zürich Competitive salary and employee stock options Budget and freedom to try new ideas Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description: Overview Physical AI, a real model of the world, is the next trillion dollar opportunity and a foundational pillar for energy, robotics and superintelligence. At Jua we are building it now. Our models already run on four continents and help power the energy buildout needed to support ever larger intelligence. We are assembling a world-class team of researchers and entrepreneurial minds to turn this model into reality at global scale. If you want the opportunity of your life, come build physical AI with us. The Role You work directly with Jua’s Leadership. You operate as a force multiplier — plugging into whatever's highest-leverage that day, from fundraising and investor work to product calls, deals, and fixing what's broken before it slows us down. What you're pulled into will shift as the business does — some stretches this is heavily fundraising and investor-facing, others it's operational firefighting or unsticking a cross-functional project. The pace is high, the context load is real, and you'll see everything. This is also a launchpad into an executive leadership role. This role is best suited for someone who has been an early-stage operator or ex-founder, and has hands-on experience with start-ups that are still in the build-phase. If that's you, expect a founder's vantage point on how Jua scales — the pace and stakes of building it yourself, without carrying it alone. What You Will Do Problem-solve directly with the leadership team on the highest-leverage issues across the business — from product, marketing and operations to fundraising and partnerships. Sit in high-stakes meetings with customers, investors, and strategic partners, and turn what happens there into clear next steps. Bring clarity to priorities and make sure decisions actually turn into action. Build lightweight dashboards and operating rhythms that help the team learn from data that's still evolving — without pretending it's cleaner than it is. Be the glue across the business: spot where cross-functional work is stuck and personally unblock it — including outside your core areas, whether that's a marketing crunch, a vendor issue, or whatever's fallen through the cracks. Write sharp briefs, investor materials, and internal notes. Handle practical execution when it matters — travel, schedules, logistics, on-site coordination. Who You Are A fast learner who can switch contexts without dropping quality — the mix of what you're doing will genuinely change over time, and you're energised by that rather than needing it to settle. Real depth in one or two areas, not experience scattered thinly across many — we'd rather see two or three things you've actually driven than a long list of things you've touched. Comfortable with data and analytical tools (vibe coding is enough) — precise enough to help the team make calls on metrics that are still taking shape, without waiting for perfect numbers. A clear, concise communicator who compresses complexity. High ownership and bias toward action. Comfortable with ambiguity — figuring things out as you go — and good at building real relationships across the team to get things done through others. Challenges directly — firm, honest input with no ego or personal agenda — then backs the CEO's call fully, including the ones that don't pan out. Spots problems before anyone else does, and gets ahead of them — not just reactive once something's already stuck. A professional background in a leadership position in one of the following domains, along with cross-functional experience in other parts of the business too : Product, Commercial, People and/or Engineering. Hands-on experience at an early-stage startup that is still building, still raising — or founder experience — is a strong plus over scale-up experience. Requirements Zurich-based strongly preferred - either current location or planning to relocate. Frequent short-notice travel to the UK, Nordics, US, and Asia. Comfortable operating at high speed with fast decision cycle

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern - Industrialization
jobs.description: ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 190 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology. We are open to internships all year round and post regularly.   We’re always looking for passionate, curious, and motivated interns to join our mission.   This is your chance to collaborate with world-class experts, gain real-world experience, and make meaningful contributions in a fast-paced, interdisciplinary environment.     The Opportunity You will join the Industrialization team, the group that turns ANYmal from something engineers can build into something a factory can build, test, and release at volume. Every robot that leaves our production line passes through the test systems this team owns. When those tests are effective, quality issues are caught in Zurich before reaching a customer's industrial site. That is the leverage of this role.Sitting directly at the intersection of software and hardware, you will write Python code to interface with physical devices, help define reliable pass/fail criteria for ANYmal subsystems, and deploy test routines to our manufacturing shopfloor. Working alongside Manufacturing Engineers, test technicians, and hardware design teams, you will gain hands-on experience bridging cutting-edge robotics design with scalable industrial production.     The Market & Our Technology ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries.
