jobs.title: Werkstudent - Sales Development Representative (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Deine Chance Als Werkstudent - Sales Development Representative (m/w/d) bist du der entscheidende Motor für die Neukundengewinnung bei Tilta. Unsere Mission: Wir helfen B2B-Unternehmen früher bezahlt zu werden - durch den Einsatz von KI und sofortigem Zugang zu Kapital. Dein wichtigstes Werkzeug: Das Telefon. Du greifst täglich zum Hörer, pitchst direkt an CFO und Finanzentscheider und deckst durch gezielte Outbound-Kampagnen echte Pain Points im Forderungsmanagement auf. Du buchst nicht nur Termine – du legst das Fundament für neue Kundenabschlüsse. Wenn du eine klare Hands-on-Mentalität mitbringst, Einwände am Telefon locker parierst und das Vertrauen von Entscheidern gewinnst, bist du bei uns genau richtig. Deine starke Leistung und das Übertreffen deiner KPIs treiben unser Wachstum direkt an und werden durch eine attraktive, ungedeckelte Provision belohnt. Das Gehalt Grundvergütung von 17 € brutto pro Stunde plus leistungsabhängige Provision pro qualifiziertem Termin. . Deine Aufgaben Dein Job ist klar: qualifizierte Erstgespräche für unser Sales-Team generieren. Outbound: Du rufst täglich Mittelständische Unternehmen an, die genau zu unserem Ideal Customer Profile passen, und erreichst die richtigen Entscheider. Gespräche & Qualifizierung: Du sprichst mit Geschäftsführung und Finanzleitung (CFO), verstehst deren Prozesse und erkennst anhand von Budget, Timing und Volumen, wer wirklich Bedarf hat. Übergabe: Du vereinbarst qualifizierte Demo-Termine für unser Management-Team, übergibst sie mit einem klaren Briefing und hältst alles nachvollziehbar im CRM fest. Nachfassen: Du hakst nach, per Telefon und bei Bedarf per E-Mail oder LinkedIn, wenn ein Gespräch nicht sofort zum Termin führt. Testen & Feedback: Du probierst neue Gesprächsansätze aus, gibst Einwände und Insights an Sales, Marketing und Product weiter und hilfst, unser Sales-Playbook zu schärfen. Dein Profil Dein Profil Du bist an einer Hochschule immatrikuliert und kannst pro Woche 12–20 Stunden arbeiten, verteilt auf mindestens 3 Tage. In der vorlesungsfreien Zeit gerne mehr. Du sprichst und schreibst sehr gutes Deutsch (C1) und gewinnst am Telefon schnell Vertrauen. Du hast Lust auf B2B-Vertrieb, greifst gern zum Hörer und bleibst bei Einwänden souverän. Du bist ehrgeizig und lässt dich gern an messbaren Ergebnissen messen. Du denkst eigenständig, holst dir aktiv Feedback und findest kreative Wege zum richtigen Ansprechpartner. Du Interesse an Startups, AI und Vertrieb hast Bonus-Punkte: Erste Erfahrung im Kundenkontakt, Promotion oder Vertrieb (Nebenjob, Praktikum, Hochschulprojekt, Verein) Interesse an Finanzen, FinTech oder B2B-Geschäftsmodellen Gute Englischkenntnisse (B2) für die interne Kommunikation Du erfüllst nicht jede Anforderung zu 100 %? Lass dich davon nicht aufhalten. Diese Liste ist keine strenge Checkliste, sondern eine Orientierung. Wenn du den nötigen Drive mitbringst, das Telefon liebst und glaubst, dass du rocken wirst, bewirb dich trotzdem. Wir suchen Persönlichkeiten, keine perfekten Lebensläufe! Warum wir? Wir erwarten nicht weniger von dir, als die Art und Weise, wie B2B-Unternehmen Geschäfte machen, nachhaltig zu verändern. Das ist eine Einladung zu einer spannenden Reise – mit komplexen Herausforderungen, harter Arbeit und genau dem Support, den du brauchst, um mit uns als Team erfolgreich zu sein. jobs.title: Founding Account Executive
jobs.description: About Zelara Most CRM marketing still blasts generic messages at scale and calls it "personalization." Our founders experienced this firsthand in senior roles at HelloFresh, Salesforce, Uber, and others. Backed by top-tier VCs, they decided to build a better way. Zelara is an agentic lifecycle marketing platform that improves with every interaction. It works with the CRM infrastructure our customers already use, replacing static journeys and manual segmentation with a system that creates content, makes individual-level decisions, and learns from every outcome. With bunq, Europe's second-largest neobank, we delivered +7.4% activation and +66% reactivation uplift , measured against a control group. We raised a €3M pre-seed and are generating revenue with paying enterprise customers. Our founders still run the commercial side themselves. We are hiring the person who takes that over and turns it into a motion that does not depend on them. The Role This is not a role where you inherit a mature sales organisation and work a territory. Leads do not arrive from marketing, opportunities do not arrive from SDRs, and there is no playbook written by someone else for you to run. This is a hands-on senior AE role: you carry a number and close your own deals. You own the commercial motion end-to-end at the moment it stops being founder-led: the pitch lands, the workshops work, paying customers are signing, and none of it is yet a system that someone other than a founder can repeat. You own the full funnel, from identifying who is worth talking to through discovery, workshop, offer, negotiation, and signature, and on into the annual contract, expansion, and renewal. Annual contracts run €75–250k . Cycles run two to four months. Buying committees are a CRM champion, a technical stakeholder, and an economic buyer, and you need to know why each of them says no. You and the Solutions Architect run each account as a pair, in a weekly rhythm and in the room together for the conversations that decide something. You are the account owner: pricing, proposals, contracts, conversion to an annual contract, expansion, renewal. They own the technical plan and the evidence behind those decisions. Before signature they lead technical discovery alongside you; after signature they become the customer's named technical lead. You close; they make the value real and defensible. You will sell to CRM, lifecycle, and marketing leaders at mid-market and enterprise B2C companies across Europe: fintech, e-commerce, travel, and employee benefits. What You Will Do Own the full funnel from ICP identification to signed contract: source, qualify, run discovery, facilitate workshops, write offers, negotiate, and close Close the next wave of customers alongside a founder, then without one, and turn closing from a personal skill into a system someone else can run Win the build-versus-buy conversation: prepare it with the Solutions Architect, bring the evidence, and make the case to an engineering lead who would rather build it Turn a working pitch into a documented playbook: write down what wins, retire what does not, and make the next hire productive from it Run outbound as an experiment rather than a spray: test channels, messaging, and segments with a stated hypothesis and a result you are willing to act on Shape ICP and positioning with real market signal, and feed what you hear in deals back to Product and Science rather than storing it in your head Build the commercial foundation: pricing logic, contract mechanics, pipeline hygiene, and a forecast that holds up Own the commercial side of expansion and renewal with the Solutions Architect: identify the opportunity, quantify the value, and de-risk the plan Lead sales as the team grows: once the motion is repeatable, hire and coach the next account executives You will not only work a pipeline. jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. Location This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region. Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp. Your Mission You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast. As a Project Manager , most of your implementations are not multi-year global programs. They are for companies that want blp running in their finance or supply chain organization within weeks, and who want somebody who knows what they are doing to take them through it. You are that person. You run the kick-off, work with them on scope and process, configure blp, coordinate the integration, take them through testing, and get them across the line at go-live. You work in three modes, and many of our Project Managers move between them: Guided onboarding for our commercial customers: you run configuration days for several customers at once, guide them while they configure, and answer the questions that come up. Leading yourself on enterprise customers: you own the project end to end, including the sponsor meetings. Alongside a Senior Project Manager on our largest programs, where you take a country, an entity or a workstream and own it. Your Career Path in Project Management This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires. Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management. Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs. Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts. Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them. Key Responsibilities Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live. Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date. Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold. jobs.title: Content Editor
jobs.description: Why work at Higgsfield AI? Higgsfield AI is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $700M in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. We write a lot, and it's read by millions of people around the world. Our content team is already strong, and now we want to make it stronger. You'll be the native voice of the brand: everything our users read will go through you. What you will work on Reviewing and editing the team's copy across the blog, Help Center, changelog, Creator Hub, case studies, PR and news, newsletters, product updates, and UI text; Fact-checking every piece before it ships: checking model and feature names against the product; Keeping facts consistent across every surface, so the same number reads the same in the blog, Help Center, landing pages, and press releases; Shaping content for AI answers: a direct answer up front, question-based headings, useful FAQs, and internal links; Keeping the writing alive and human, with no traces of AI or template-speak; Working on tone, rhythm and clarity, not just fixing grammar; Writing your own pieces too, including editorial work like our Inside Higgsfield series; Holding one consistent brand voice across everything we publish. Your must haves English as your native language; A strong background in editing and writing, with a portfolio to show for it; An instinct for style, tone and rhythm. You feel when a sentence works and when it doesn't; The ability to explain your edits and how they make the text stronger. "It sounds better" is a start, not an answer; An owner mindset: you see what could be better, and you make it happen; Comfort with startup pace. We move fast, ship weekly, and the writing has to keep up. Nice to have Experience editing for a tech, SaaS or AI product; Experience building or maintaining a style guide or brand voice; Familiarity with the GenAI landscape and the tools creators actually use; The deal Competitive salary in USD; Fully remote position; Access to Higgsfield products and the AI tools we use internally; Full-time position with high ownership and growth potential. jobs.title: Werksstudenten ISMS & Compliance (m/w/d) - Berlin
jobs.description: Die Solarize Energy Solutions GmbH mit Büros in Berlin und Stuttgart revolutioniert die Energiewirtschaft mit innovativer Meter-to-Cash-Software . Wir ermöglichen es Energieunternehmen, innovative Produkte anzubieten, von denen sowohl die Kunden als auch die Energiewende profitieren. Ursprünglich für Mieterstrom in Gewerbeimmobilien entwickelt, unterstützt Solarize heute über 200 Unternehmen als Abrechnungslösung für PPAs, Mieterstrom, Wärme bis hin zu komplexen zeitreihenbasierten Energieprodukten im Geschäftskundenbereich. Das Solarize-Team besteht aus erfahrenen Gründern, Pionieren der Energiewende, Softwareexperten und hungrigen Macher:innen, die in einer offenen Kultur und im ständigen Austausch miteinander an den wichtigen Fragen der Energiewende arbeiten. Wir sind ausdauernd, wissbegierig, veränderungswillig und unbequem. So verändern wir den Energiesektor hin zu einer kundenorientierten und innovativen Branche und leisten dadurch unseren Beitrag für die zentralen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit. Energieversorger vertrauen uns ihre Abrechnungsdaten an. Deshalb ist Informationssicherheit bei uns Teil des Produkts. Für unser Büro in Berlin suchen wir eine:n Werkstudent:in ISMS & Compliance (m/w/d) , der:die unser nach ISO/IEC 27001:2022 zertifiziertes ISMS mitgestaltet und weiterentwickelt. Aufgaben Deine Mission bei uns Du sorgst mit dafür, dass die Plattform für die Energiewende sicher bleibt. Dabei lernst du Informationssicherheit so kennen, wie sie in einem wachsenden SaaS-Unternehmen tatsächlich gelebt wird. Halte unser ISMS auditfest: Du unterstützt dabei, die Anforderungen der ISO/IEC 27001:2022 im Alltag umzusetzen und zu überprüfen. Du pflegst Richtlinien, Nachweise und Risikobewertungen und begleitest interne und externe Audits aus erster Reihe. Mach Sicherheit messbar: Du definierst aussagekräftige KPIs für unser ISMS, erhebst sie möglichst automatisiert und machst sie in Dashboards sichtbar. Aus den Zahlen leitest du konkrete Verbesserungen ab. Entwickle das ISMS weiter: Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie Prozesse schlanker, Kontrollen wirksamer und Dokumentation hilfreicher werden. Dein Ziel ist ein ISMS, das im Arbeitsalltag unterstützt und auch gelebt wird. Sichere unsere Geräteflotte: Du gestaltest das Mobile Device Management unserer Firmengeräte aktiv mit, von Sicherheitsrichtlinien und Konfigurationsprofilen bis zum Rollout für mobile Geräte. Gestalte Information Security im KI-Zeitalter: Du findest Antworten auf eine der spannendsten Fragen unserer Branche: Wie setzen wir KI-Tools produktiv ein und schützen gleichzeitig die Daten unserer Kunden zuverlässig? Dafür entwickelst du Richtlinien, Freigabeprozesse und technische Leitplanken, die Sicherheit und Effizienz verbinden. Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Engineering-Team und den Verantwortlichen für Informationssicherheit zusammen und übersetzt Sicherheitsanforderungen in praktikable Lösungen. Qualifikation Wir glauben fest daran, dass die richtige Einstellung und Motivation oft wichtiger sind als ein lückenloser Lebenslauf. Das bringst du mit (Must-haves): Studium mit Tech-Fokus: Du studierst Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, (IT-)Sicherheit, Security Management oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang, zum Beispiel an der TU Berlin, HTW, BHT oder am HPI in Potsdam. Echtes Interesse an Informationssicherheit: Du hast erste Berührungspunkte gesammelt, etwa über Vorlesungen, Projekte, CTFs oder dein eigenes Homelab, und willst wissen, wie Security in der Praxis funktioniert. Technisches Grundverständnis: Du verstehst, wie Cloud-Infrastruktur, Identitäts- und Zugriffsmanagement und Endgeräte zusammenspielen. Mit Python, Bash oder TypeScript automatisierst du wiederkehrende Aufgaben. KI-gestützte Arbeitsweise: Du nutzt KI-Tools gezielt, prüfst ihre Ergebnisse kritisch und hast ein Gespür dafür, welche Daten in welches Tool gehören. Struktur und Sorgfalt: Du arbeitest gewissenhaft, behältst auch bei vielen Anforderungen den Übe

jobs.title: Sponsorship Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Wir sind GORNATION, eine Sportmarke aus Münster, gegründet 2015 mit der Mission, Calisthenics weltweit zu stärken. Unsere Produkte werden in über 100 Ländern genutzt, von Trainings-Equipment bis Streetwear. Auf Instagram erreichen wir bereits über 270.000 Menschen. Ein wichtiger Teil dieser Reichweite sind unsere Affiliates: Athleten und Creator, die Calisthenics leben und GORNATION in die Szene tragen. Wir suchen einen Sponsorship Manager, der diese Partnerschaften betreut und ausbaut. Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere Affiliates, sorgst für schnelle Antworten und verlässliche Kommunikation und hältst im Sponsorship-Team den Laden am Laufen. Dein Ziel: Affiliates, die sich bei GORNATION gut betreut fühlen, Projekte, die sauber laufen, und ein Sponsorship-Team mit Kapazität, weiter zu wachsen. Arbeitsmodell: ab 30 Stunden/Woche, vor Ort in Münster Start: 01.01.2027 Aufgaben Kommunikation: Du bist erste Ansprechperson für Affiliates und externe Partner, auch über WhatsApp Feedback & Verträge: Du führst Feedbackgespräche und Vertragsverhandlungen, die für GORNATION und den jeweiligen Affiliate passen Tracking: Du trackst Content und die Einhaltung der Vertragsbedingungen On- & Offboarding: Du begleitest Affiliates beim Einstieg und beim Abschied Bestellungen & Auszahlungen: Du organisierst Sponsorship-Bestellungen, monatliche Payouts und den Versand von Paketen Teamarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Sponsorship-Team und punktuell mit dem Event- und Social-Media-Team zusammen Qualifikation Organisation: Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und übernimmst Verantwortung Kommunikation: Du kommunizierst persönlich, empathisch und lösungsorientiert, auch bei kurzfristigen Änderungen Verhandlung: Du findest Lösungen, bei denen beide Seiten gewinnen Marketing-Verständnis: Du kennst Social Media und die Grundprinzipien erfolgreicher Promotions Szenebezug: Du hast einen Bezug zu Fitness und Calisthenics Sprachkenntnisse: Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Plus: Französisch- und Italienischkenntnisse, Erfahrung mit Asana oder anderen Projekttools, Erfahrung im Influencer- oder Affiliate-Management, im Content-Bereich, ein Netzwerk in der Fitness-Community oder als eigener Creator Benefits Top Arbeits-Equipment: Du bekommst ein MacBook für deine Arbeit, das dir hilft, produktiv und effizient zu arbeiten. Fitness inklusive: Wir trainieren regelmäßig gemeinsam nach der Arbeit, entweder in unserem Fitnessraum im Office-Gebäude oder draußen. jobs.title: Senior Industrial Designer | Robotics
jobs.description: Your tasks Shape the hardware identity: Define how our humanoids look and feel: proportions, surfaces, overall silhouette. You take the design direction we already have and carry it through to physical systems that actually ship. Design for passive safety first: Safety sits in the geometry from the first sketch. You work through clearances, pinch points, contact surfaces and fall behavior so the robot is safe around people before software gets involved. Integrate complex systems: Package the internals (sensors, cameras, cooling, connectors, cable routing) so the technical parts look intended. Physical human machine interaction: Design status signals, touchpoints and small physical cues that tell the people working next to the robot what it is doing and what comes next. Build the ecosystem around the robot: Extend the design language to charging docks, transport cases, maintenance gear and packaging. From model to CAD: You build physical models fast, see what holds up, and change them until they do. Then you do the surfacing and hand over CAD that engineering can build from directly. Materials and processes: Select finishes, review physical samples, and work suppliers on feasibility, cost and lead times. You are willing to try materials that are not standard and to bring in specialized external labs. Your profile Background: A degree in industrial or product design, or an engineering degree where the design side is clearly the stronger half. Experience: Around five years or more designing physical products, in house or at a studio. Robotics, medical devices, lab and industrial equipment, mobility, or another field where the hardware has to hold up in front of people. Small series: You have worked on products built in the hundreds rather than the millions, and know how much that changes what a shape can be. Safety and regulation: You have designed under mechanical safety requirements before, so guarding, clearances and contact safety are familiar territory rather than a new topic. Tools: Surface modeling in Rhino, Onshape, SolidWorks or Fusion, plus 3D printing and enough workshop practice to build your own models. Working with engineers: You read mechanical drawings, keep up in technical discussions, and can explain why a design decision matters. Languages: Fluent English. German is nice to have, not a requirement. Why us? Ownership from day one: The physical design and hardware identity of our humanoids is yours. Short decisions, no approval chains, and you work directly with the founders and lead engineers. Everything under one roof: Labs, workshop and test rigs are in the same Kreuzberg building. The engineer you need is a walk away, not a ticket. Room to get better: Paid learning time and a personal budget for it, projects where something is allowed to not work the first time, and support for portfolio work and conference talks as the company becomes known. Benefits: A benefits package you put together yourself, covering mobility, home setup, health or food. Plus one extra paid day off a year for volunteering or a project you care about. How to Apply Send us your portfolio and a few lines about one product you took from sketch to production : what changed along the way, and why. No cover letter needed. Process : Intro call -> Portfolio deep-dive with the founders -> Half-day on-site visit with a small design exercise -> Offer. We build robots for everyone, so we want a team that reflects that. jobs.title: Senior Product Owner (m/f/d) - Team Search
jobs.description: At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership.   Flix is building the global platform for affordable and sustainable ground travel, from next-generation train offerings in Europe to rapid expansion in high-growth markets such as India. As our network becomes broader and more complex, Search plays a critical role in helping millions of customers find the right journey quickly, confidently, and intuitively. As a Senior Product Owner/Manager in Demand Division you will be able to turn Search into a true growth engine for Flix: a product experience that understands customer intent, reduces complexity, improves conversion, and creates valuable demand signals for the business across web, app, and emerging AI-native channels. In this role, you will define the north star for Flix Search and own the roadmap through a major product and technical transformation. You will work closely with engineering, UX, data, commercial, and operational stakeholders to evolve Search from a functional step in the booking funnel into a personalised, intelligent, and scalable discovery experience. About the Role Set and communicate a compelling product vision and strategy for Search, grounded in customer needs, business impact, and market opportunity Identify and prioritise opportunities across ranking, relevance, comparison, query understanding, personalisation, and zero-result recovery Use data such as conversion impact, query behaviour, and customer feedback to diagnose problems and guide product decisions Lead discovery and delivery with cross-functional teams, balancing quick customer-facing improvements with long-term platform and architectural needs Align stakeholders around trade-offs, success metrics, and roadmap priorities in an ambiguous and strategically important product area Explore how Search can support new surfaces and behaviours, including AI-native discovery and conversational travel planning About You You have 8+ years of product management experience, ideally including ownership of a search, discovery, marketplace, recommendation, or other high-intent digital product You have led meaningful product changes in complex environments and can connect product strategy with hands-on execution You are highly data-informed and know how to turn behavioural, funnel, and query-level insights into clear product direction You are comfortable partnering with engineering on technical topics such as APIs, ranking, machine learning, performance, and architectural trade-offs You are a strong communicator who can build trust across engineering, UX, data, and business teams and create alignment when priorities compete You are energised by unsolved problems and motivated to understand why a customer experience is not working, not only how to close the next ticket You are fluent in English Nice to have: Experience with travel, mobility, marketplaces, e-commerce, or other high-scale consumer platforms Experience building or improving AI-assisted, personalised, or conversational discovery experiences German or another European language jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Executive, London
jobs.description: We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science. We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world. World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached. Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you. ABOUT THE ROLE Open to hiring remote in London, UK. You will carry a book of 40-60 mid-market and emerging accounts - companies in the <$1B range, closing 25-40 deals a year at $40k-$100k and building toward larger standard deal sizes as our packaging moves upmarket. You work in a pod with a dedicated Mid-Market Engagement Manager on a shared book, with a comp plan designed to maximize earnings and customer value. We are architecting the best GTM team in all of AI. If you want to grow, run fast, and sell with a leading-edge frontier AI company with room to grow your career, please apply. WHAT YOU'LL DO Run a high-velocity full-cycle motion: 25-40 closed deals a year across inbound and outbound Qualify hard and fast - your book is big, your calendar is the scarce resource, orientation to clear ROI and value orientation is a must Push deal size up: committed-volume, use-case expansion plays that turn $30k starts into $100k+ repeatable motions Turn product signals (usage spikes, team signups, credit burn) into pipeline Work with your pod's Engagement Manager so new customers hit consumption targets and your held-back commission unlocks WHAT YOU'LL NEED 3+ years of full-cycle closing experience in SaaS/AI with a quota record above 100% Velocity evidence: 20+ closed deals a year, multi-channel prospecting, disciplined qualification Native AI-tool fluency - you already sell with AI in your workflow, not despite it Writing and demo skills strong enough to carry a deal without a solutions engineer Coachability with a track record: name the coaching that changed your numbers STRONG CANDIDATES MAY ALSO HAVE Sold to creative or marketing teams PLG or usage-signal selling experience BDR-to-AE promotion in your history - we like people who earned the chair COMPENSATION OTE $270K - $300K (50/50 base to variable). Offers equity. Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide. There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range. Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates. Working at Runway Great things come from great teams. We’d love to hear from you. We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer
jobs.description: Lead Product Designer - Cortex 📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH) 💰 Competitive salary, dependent on experience Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to transform the experience of buying, selling, renting and letting property, elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology. Cortex is an exciting new product that brings agentic AI into Street and Spectre, taking on the busywork so agents can focus on winning instructions and building relationships. It's early, moving fast, and will ultimately touch every part of the product suite. We're looking for a Lead Product Designer to shape what agentic UX looks like across all of it. We want someone who is genuinely excited by agentic AI, past needing to be told what's worth working on, and ready to help define a product category that doesn't have a playbook yet - working closely with senior stakeholders across the business. If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you. At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. You'll drive direction alongside product and engineering, not respond to them. Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask. We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping. Here's what you can expect to be working on Shape the UX of agentic AI across Street and Spectre - deciding which agency workflows agents should own, then designing how that actually feels and builds trust for the user. Design across the whole suite, not one domain - valuation, prospecting, marketing, enquiry handling, sales progression, property management. You'll hold a huge amount of context. Define the patterns for a new category. There's no established playbook for agentic UX in property - you'll set it. Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like. Prototype, test and ship at pace - getting working prototypes in front of real agents and iterating fast. You should apply if: You've built or shaped agentic AI, not just used AI tools - multi-step, tool-using agents you've designed, prototyped or shipped. You understand how they work and where they break. You've got a well-formed point of view on agentic UX - how you design for systems that don't always behave the same way, how you build in trust, transparency and control, and when to keep a human in the loop. You stay current. This field moves monthly and you keep on top of it. You're energised by an undefined problem space and bring the case for what's worth doing, rather than waiting for a brief. You're commercially fluent - you make design trade-offs informed by how the product performs, not just user preference. You define success before you ship and read the result after. You probably shouldn't apply if: Your AI experience is limited to speeding up your own workflow. This role is about designing AI into the product, and that gap will show quickly. You're looking for the next pay band up from Senior with broadly similar expectations. This is not a "Senior+" role - it expects materially more scope, autonomy and judgment. You need a well-defined problem before you can start. Cortex is still taking shape, and that won't change soon. You expect to be handed a roadmap. Here, you help write it. A bit about you AI & agentic depth: Non-negotiable, and the first thing we'll screen for. Current, hands-on knowledge of agentic AI, with real examples of what you've built or shaped. Craft: Lead-level UX and product design. Your work is exemplary and you can articulate it clearly enough to teach. Breadth: Comfortable operating across the whole product suite and holding a lot of context at once, not going deep on a single domain. Amb

jobs.description: Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets. We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in. Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits. We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors. Why we're hiring We are automating a decades old part of the financial services industry. AI pilled operators like you are the beating heart of this plan, because LLMs & agents allow us to turn this services business entirely into software. We're post-PMF, fast-growing, and rolling out new products (fund admin) & geographies (USA). Customer & deal volume is climbing fast. Today we're on track for roughly 700 deals a year, with a team of ~20, and we’ll process $500m-$750m of investment in 2026 alone. The next goal is 7,000 deals a year and billions in annual investment flows. We believe this can be achieved with a team of around 50 people. But it will only be possible if we turn human-driven services workflows into software. The operational machine behind Odin is still held together in many places by people and spreadsheets. Your job is to come in, understand every process and system, simplify, streamline and automate the shit out of it. You’ll be part of a small elite team embedded in operations and working closely with existing team members to build agents that automate work. We expect the right hire to be spending more time in Claude Code than in Excel, email or anything else. Your job is to understand them well enough to redesign, automate and build better ways of doing them. Build and automate: You’ll turn manual workflows into tools, automations and systems that make the business faster and more scalable. You’ll work autonomously and move quickly - often vibe coding something useful yourself before it ever needs traditional product or engineering resource. Bridge operations and engineering: You’ll know when something can be solved with process, automation or a lightweight build, and when it genuinely needs deeper engineering work. When it does, you’ll bring Product, Design and Engineering in with the problem already understood, simplified and proven. Delete things and say no: You’ll constantly question why a process exists, whether a request should be supported, and whether something is worth scaling. If a workflow exists for no good reason, you kill it. If a request creates complexity without enough value, we don’t do it. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. &nbsp;</p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. jobs.description: About Unity Advisory Unity Advisory is a pure-play, experience-led CFO advisory firm providing integrated finance, commercial, tax and deals support. We are free from audit conflicts and AI-enabled by design, combining deep technical expertise with automation, analytics and AI built into the delivery of every engagement. We are building an alternative to traditional advisory firms, focused on clarity over complexity, outcomes over hours, and practical advice delivered at pace for CFOs making high-consequence decisions. The Role As a Finance Transformation Manager, you will lead workstreams within high-impact transformation programmes — working directly with CFOs and their leadership teams to re-imagine and digitise finance functions through digital technologies, streamlined processes and modern operating models. This is a client-facing role at a firm that does things differently. There are no legacy layers here — you’ll take real ownership, shape the work, and have direct visibility of the impact you create from day one. If you’ve built strong credentials in finance transformation and want to apply them somewhere that moves at pace and actually values your expertise, this is that role. Responsibilities • Advise CFOs and their leadership teams on transformation priorities and approach. • Lead and manage finance transformation workstreams across process, data and technology. • Design future-state finance operating models tailored to client context. • Redesign core finance processes including R2R, P2P, O2C and FP&A. • Implement cloud-based ERP and EPM platforms, automation tools, data platforms and analytics solutions. • Translate business requirements into practical ERP/EPM solutions and integrate technology into clients’ ecosystems. • Drive adoption of transformation initiatives so the changes stick after we leave. • Run executive workshops and lead steering committee updates. • Ensure delivery on time, on budget and within scope. • Lead, coach and develop team members. • Contribute to go-to-market activities, proposal writing and pitch presentations. • Support thought leadership on EPM trends and tools. What you'll bring 6+ years of experience in finance transformation including 2+ years in a consulting or advisory environment. Track record of delivering high-impact tech-enabled Finance Transformation programmes. Experience implementing ERP, EPM, analytics tools and automation platforms. Experience in process re-engineering and operating model design. Finance/Accounting qualification including ACA/ACCA/CIMA/CPA Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. jobs.title: Research Scientist, Computational Enzymology
jobs.description: About us We're reverse-engineering the origin of life — one of the great unsolved problems in science, and one we think AI finally makes tractable. Understanding this transition, from geochemistry to biochemistry, is what will let us orchestrate molecular networks and build systems that are more capable, adaptive, and efficient. If we succeed, the applications are vast: catalysis, green synthesis, ab initio synthetic biology, programmable matter. Understanding and harnessing these processes could let ten billion of us thrive on this planet — and let life keep evolving beyond it. We're a small, diverse team of AI engineers, computational scientists, and bench scientists. We hold ourselves to the rigor of a research institute, but we ship like an engineering firm. Global team, HQs in Cambridge, MA and London, UK. The role You'll simulate enzyme-catalysed reactions from the physics up. Using reactive and free-energy methods you'll map how reactions proceed in the active site, compute transition states and barriers, and work out where the catalysis actually comes from: why a step has the barrier it does, which residues do the work, and how mutations move it. You'll work with the wider simulation and ML teams, but also directly with our bench scientists — seeing your predictions tested in vitro and getting experimental feedback on fast, tight loops. What you'll do Characterise mechanisms, transition states, and activation barriers in the active site, and compare computed barriers against measured kinetics Pin down the origins of catalysis — the residues, interactions, and dynamics that set rate and selectivity — and use MD to understand how active-site motion shapes the reaction Turn results into concrete, testable proposals for the wet lab, and fold the resulting data back into your models Help physics-based and learned methods strengthen each other as we build them out Essential experience . Expertise in enzymatic reaction modelling using QM/MM and a variety of free energy methods A solid grasp of enzyme catalysis: mechanism, kinetics, cofactors, and how active-site chemistry and conformational dynamics sets rate and selectivity Sound judgement about method selection, good understanding o methodological limitations and computational cost Highly preferred Experience in protein design for enzymatic optimization You've run design–test–refine cycles with a wet lab before Experience with reactive machine-learned potentials, or coupling physics-based modelling with ML Logistics Compensation is highly competitive. jobs.title: Technical Lead, Machine Learning
jobs.description: About the Role There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things As Technical Lead, Machine Learning, you own the execution layer of our intelligence, turning research and model capabilities into reliable, scalable production systems. You will work across the model lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, inference, and deployment. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who wants to operate at the intersection of research, systems, and product. What You'll Own Own the end-to-end ML systems powering our company, from data and training to evaluation, inference, and deployment. Build and evolve training and fine-tuning pipelines for large models. Design evaluation systems that measure capability, robustness, safety, and real-world product performance. Architect high-performance inference systems, optimizing latency, GPU utilization, memory, cost, and reliability. Build data pipelines and systems for high-quality real-world and synthetic training data. Establish reliable production infrastructure for deploying, monitoring, and continuously improving models. Partner closely with research and application engineering to turn model capabilities into product improvements. Make pragmatic technical trade-offs and rapidly iterate based on real-world performance. What We're Looking For Experience building and shipping ML systems used in production, not just research prototypes. Strong understanding of modern large-model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and inference. Strong software engineering and systems fundamentals. Experience operating ML workloads at meaningful scale, particularly GPU-based systems. Strong technical judgment and the ability to navigate ambiguous problems independently. A bias toward experimentation, measurement, and shipping. High standards for correctness, reliability, and production quality. Outcomes Research and models reliably translate into production-ready solutions with clear performance and quality targets. ML pipelines, training loops, and inference systems are stable, efficient, and maintainable. Production issues are detected, debugged, and resolved quickly, minimizing user impact. Team members are supported, aligned, and able to deliver high-impact ML work with minimal friction. Iterations on models and systems are measurable, safe, and improve user experience over time. Tech Stack Python PyTorch / JAX GPU-based training and inference system Ideal Experience You have built or shipped real ML systems used by people, not just demos. You are comfortable working with large models and understanding their failure modes. You write strong, production-grade code and care about system correctness. How We Work We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently. We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional. Interview process If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews. Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite. We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us

jobs.title: Automation Lead
jobs.description: About us, and our mission At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with a large cohort of patient-derived tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical outcomes, validate therapies and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we aim to make drug development smarter, faster and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies. Backed by leading investors, Orakl is a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of biology, automation and AI. Position overview Orakl runs a high-throughput 3D cell‑culture platform to culture patient-derived organoids (PDOs). These patient-derived specimens reveal critical information into the patient disease, but require heavy maintenance work. Automating these workflows will be critical to improve the reliability and traceability of experimental work. We are hiring our first automation lead to build the Automation function from scratch. This is a high ownership and high autonomy job. You will map our processes, decide what to automate and what to leave alone, specify and source the equipment, negotiate with vendors and integrators, commission the machines, run them with the lab team, and hire the people the function needs. As the ideal candidate, you have already put automated lines or special machines into service, and you know what typically breaks between commissioning and the first experimental runs. While previous experience in biology is a plus, it is not a strict requirement: you will be taught all you need to know. However, you do need a proven experience in working deeply embedded in interdisciplinary teams. Key responsibilities Map cell culture workflows end to end and identify key process automation and optimisation opportunities. Own the automation roadmap. Present and lead the implementation of the major decisions to Orakl’s leadership. In line with the automation strategy you will have identified, evaluate vendors and integrators. Write user requirement specifications, acceptance criteria and interface requirements for each project. Negotiate price, scope, delivery, acceptance, support and consumables terms autonomously within agreed thresholds. Lead design reviews and factory and site acceptance tests. Translate our proprietary cell culture protocols into automated machine execution with our team of cell biologists and scientists. Track machine availability, hands-on time per line, interventions, failures and recovery time. Use the data to decide the next step. Coordinate with Orakl’s management to anticipate future automation needs on the platform and adjust the roadmap accordingly. Hire and develop the automation technicians and engineers the roadmap needs. Set the standards for the automated platform: documentation, quality control, safety, qualification, change control, vendor management. In this role you will collaborate closely with our cell culture, cell biology and data science teams. You will be at the heart of Orakl Oncology’s capabilities roadmap and help generate unprecedented amounts of biological data to power scientific discovery in cancer. Key qualifications Must-have Engineering degree (generalist, robotics, industrial, mechanical or process engineering) or equivalent, and at least eight years of experience. Exceptional process thinking skills: you map flows, time operations, find bottlenecks and question the processes. Experience in supplier negotiation and budget ownership on your own projects. Experience in PLC and robot programming concepts, scheduling software, instrument interfaces, basic scripting. You enjoy and are comfortable spending time on the floor with operators. Familiarity with defense sensing and tracking problem domains. jobs.description: Présentation de Télécom SudParis : Télécom SudParis est une grande école publique d'ingénieurs reconnue au meilleur niveau des sciences et technologies du numérique. Télécom SudParis compte 1 000 étudiantes et étudiants dont 700 élèves ingénieurs et environ de 150 doctorantes et doctorants. Télécom SudParis fait partie de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’école d’ingénieurs en France, et partage son campus avec Institut Mines-Télécom Business School. Télécom SudParis est co- fondatrice de l'Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris), Institut de Sciences et Technologies à vocation mondiale avec l’École polytechnique, l’ENSTA Paris, l’ENSAE Paris, l'ENPC et Télécom Paris. Vidéo présentation de Télécom SudParis À propos de l'Institut Mines-Télécom : L'Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un établissement public dédié à l'enseignement supérieur et la recherche pour l'innovation dans les domaines de l'ingénierie et du numérique. Concevoir et évaluer des approches de protection de la vie privée dans des environnements d’apprentissage décentralisé, en particulier dans le cadre de l’apprentissage fédéré. Identifier et caractériser les vulnérabilités de sécurité propres à l’apprentissage collaboratif et fédéré, notamment les attaques par empoisonnement de données, l’injection de portes dérobées ( backdoors ) et les attaques visant la confidentialité des données et des utilisateurs. jobs.description: Rejoignez Excelya, où Audace, Bienveillance et Énergie sont au cœur de notre façon de travailler. Nous favorisons un environnement collaboratif dans lequel chacun peut développer son expertise et contribuer à des projets à forte valeur ajoutée dans le secteur des Life Sciences. Dans le cadre de projets stratégiques au sein d'un environnement pharmaceutique, nous recherchons un Ingénieur Assurance Qualité Projets – Qualification & Validation pour accompagner des projets de transfert entrant de produits en formes sèches et conditionnement . Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble des activités Qualité associées aux projets, depuis la définition de la stratégie de qualification jusqu'à l'exécution des qualifications et au suivi du système qualité. Piloter le système qualité à l'échelle des projets : Change Controls, CAPA, déviations et gestion documentaire . Réaliser les analyses de criticité et analyses de risques relatives aux équipements et systèmes mis en place. Rédiger et revoir la documentation de qualification : FAT, SAT, QI, QO, QE et QP , selon les besoins des projets. Participer aux réunions de suivi des projets et assurer la représentation de l'Assurance Qualité auprès des différentes parties prenantes. Veiller au respect des plannings de qualification et assurer le suivi des activités Qualité associées aux projets. Contribuer aux démarches réglementaires nécessaires dans le cadre des modifications apportées aux installations. Qualification/Validation : Vous maîtrisez les activités de qualification d'équipements ainsi que la rédaction et l'exécution des protocoles et rapports associés. Qualité : Vous êtes à l'aise avec la gestion des Change Controls, CAPA, déviations, analyses de risques et documentation GMP . Réglementaire : Vous avez une bonne connaissance des GMP européennes et FDA , de l' Annexe 15 des EU GMP , du 21 CFR Part 11 , des principes GAMP 5 , ICH Q9 et ALCOA+ . Formation : Formation Ingénieur, Pharmacien ou niveau scientifique/technique équivalent. Qualités personnelles : Rigueur, autonomie, organisation, capacités rédactionnelles et de synthèse, aisance relationnelle et capacité à travailler en équipe projet. Langues : Anglais professionnel niveau B2 minimum , permettant de rédiger de la documentation GMP en anglais et de participer à des réunions ou échanges avec des interlocuteurs internationaux. Ce qui nous distingue : Nous sommes une entreprise de santé ambitieuse qui offre à ses collaborateurs l'opportunité d'évoluer sur des projets variés et à forte valeur ajoutée. jobs.title: CDI - BARISTA - Flagship Le Marais
jobs.description: AMI cherche un.e nouvel.le ambassadeur.drice BARISTA pour rejoindre notre Flagship du Marais . Chez AMI, nous avons à cœur de créer une expérience client à la fois chaleureuse, authentique et exigeante, à l’image de notre Maison. Sous la responsabilité du Store Manager, vous contribuez à offrir une expérience accueillante et qualitative à nos clients à travers la préparation et le service des boissons, tout en veillant à la qualité et au bon fonctionnement de l’espace Café de la boutique. Vos principales missions seront les suivantes :   Accueil et relation client Accueillir chaque client, conseiller sur la carte, créer une expérience à la hauteur de l'image de la Maison Assurer la fluidité du service en période d'affluence Faire le lien avec les équipes de la boutique : le Café et le Retail partagent le même espace et la même clientèle Préparation des boissons Extraction espresso, boissons lactées et latte art. Création de recettes d'espresso et de filtre pour chaque nouveau café. Réglages quotidiens du moulin et de la machine, contrôle de la constance tout au long du service Dégustation et ajustement des recettes, participation aux évolutions de la carte Gestion des stocks et des achats Suivi des niveaux de stock (café, lait, consommables, packaging) Passage des commandes fournisseurs et relation directe avec eux (torréfacteur, grossistes, consommables) Réception et contrôle des livraisons, gestion des DLC, limitation des pertes Inventaires réguliers et remontée des écarts Gestion du matériel Nettoyage quotidien et hebdomadaire des machines, du moulin et de l'ensemble du poste Planification et suivi des maintenances préventives, gestion de la relation avec les techniciens Détection et signalement des dysfonctionnements, gestion des interventions curatives Respect et suivi des règles d'hygiène applicables au poste Encadrement Encadrer et former le second barista : gestes techniques, standards de service, montée en compétence Organiser les plannings du binôme et la répartition des tâches Participer aux recrutements à venir : définition du besoin, entretiens, intégration des nouveaux arrivants Expérience confirmée en tant que barista en coffee shop de spécialité (2 à 3 ans minimum) -Maîtrise technique : réglages, extraction, latte art -Autonomie démontrée sur les stocks et la relation fournisseurs -À l'aise avec l'entretien et la maintenance courante du matériel -Connaissance de la filière café de spécialité (torréfacteurs, sourcing, tendances) Vous êtes curieux.se et avez envie de vous investir dans un tout nouveau projet. Vous êtes souriant.e, dynamique, impliqué.e et doté.e d'excellentes qualités relationnelles. Vous avez un sens développé du service client et avez à cœur de satisfaire les besoins de la clientèle. Vous avez une forte sensibilité pour la Mode et à l'univers de la marque La pratique de l'anglais est indispensable . Date de démarrage : 15 novembre. Why join the « F.ami.LY »? Ami Paris se distingue par la sincérité de son expression. Nous réunissons des personnes passionnées et motivées, qui travaillent avec cœur et une énergie positive dans un cadre respectueux. Chaque membre de l’équipe contribue à créer un environnement dynamique, ou créativité et engagement vont de pair. Rejoignez une Maison de mode en pleine croissance, engagée et bienveillante, où chacun peut apporter sa personnalité et contribuer à une aventure collective. Nous recherchons des personnalités qui savent créer du lien, prendre des initiatives et faire preuve d’implication. Chez Ami, la qualité de l’expérience client repose autant sur le savoir-faire que sur le savoir-être : confiance, optimisme, créativité, engagement et esprit d’équipe. Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité de nos équipes est une force. Nous étudions toutes les candidatures avec la même attention, sans distinction de genre, de handicap, d'origine, d'âge ou d'orientation.   Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche. Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt. Deine Rolle bei June Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO. Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche. Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen. Anforderungen Was du mitbringst Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten. Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich) Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools. Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs). AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst. Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch. Das wäre ein Plus Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel. Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung. Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience. Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort. Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst. Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen. Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich. Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team. Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June. So arbeiten wir Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs. Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern. Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht. Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release. Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen. Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team

jobs.title: Data Center Facilities Operations Technician (all genders)
jobs.description: Your creative field We are looking for a full-time, permanent Data Center Facilities Operations Technician (all genders) to join our new data center in Lauterbourg as soon as possible . Our customers all around the world rely on Contabo's infrastructure. With our support they run their businesses and store their data. What they never see is what makes it all possible: the humming servers, the precisely cooled halls and our power systems that never sleep. That's your world. As a Data Center Facilities Operations Technician at our Lauterbourg site, you are the person who makes sure the lights stay on. You know your facility better than anyone: every cable tray, every cooling unit, every alarm. You monitor and maintain our complete infrastructure: electrical systems from MV/LV distribution to grounding, UPS systems kept tested and ready and HVAC/cooling systems that keep everything running at optimal temperature and efficiency. You work hands-on with our Building Management System, catch issues before they become incidents and when something does go wrong, you're the one who keeps calm, diagnoses fast and gets things back on track. Beyond day-to-day operations, you'll plan and execute preventive maintenance, coordinate with external subcontractors and continuously push to make our processes sharper and more reliable. Over time, you'll take the lead on maintenance activities, develop predictive approaches and eventually help shape the infrastructure strategy itself. Also it’s important that you have fun to pass your knowledge on to our technicians in the team. To be honest: there's never been a more exciting time to join us. We're not just maintaining a data center; we're still in the process building one hall. A brand-new HPC facility is taking shape on site and you'll be part of that from The Ground up. Your fingerprints will be on the infrastructure that powers Contabo's next chapter. What convinces us Your personality, paired with: 3+ years of hands-on experience in facilities, HVAC or electrical maintenance Knowledge of HVAC and cooling systems - this is your core strength Familiarity with electrical systems (MV/LV), UPS and BMS platforms Valid electrical safety or HVAC certification (or equivalent) Safety-first mindset: you follow protocols and set the standard for others Cool under pressure, reliable and comfortable with on-call rotations Strong communicator who works well in a team and with external contractors Good English skills; German and/or French are a plus Data center or industrial facility background is also a plus Technical diploma or vocational training in electrical engineering, HVAC or facility management is a helpful add on We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference. Awesome Prospects At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference. What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint. Additionally, we offer: great freedom for your creative ideas. ongoing professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative and technological environment. Convenient transport connections, new modern and well-equipped office and workshop space with the option to contribute creatively to the design. support with your relocation a comprehensive induction with your colleagues by your side. 30-day vacation by default. an extra day off to get involved in social activities as part of our Volunteer Day. attractive conditions on many products and services through our corporate benefits program. unforgettable moments at our company events and team events. How to reach us If you have any questions, you can reach out to Alin

jobs.title: Tracking Specialist Intern
jobs.description: Hi, we’re Back Market. We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new. Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. Are you ready to join us? JOB DESCRIPTION: The Data & Measurement team makes sure every interaction on our website and apps is measured accurately, reliably and in a privacy-compliant way. We own the tracking architecture (Google Tag Manager web and server-side, GA4, advertising platform tags) across 17 markets. The data we collect powers marketing performance, product analytics and business decisions across the company. Be a part of the movement. Join the circular revolution. YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇 Implement and maintain tags, triggers and variables in our Google Tag Manager containers (web and server-side), for analytics and advertising platforms such as Google Ads and Meta. Specify and QA dataLayer events with our developers, and make sure new features ship with the right tracking. Run tracking audits and QA across markets: detect broken or missing events, investigate data discrepancies, and follow fixes through to production. Contribute to tracking monitoring by building checks and alerts on data quality in BigQuery. Make sure tracking respects user consent choices and privacy regulations, working with our consent management platform and legal teams. Keep our tracking plan and documentation up to date, so every team knows what is collected and why. Answer tracking questions from Marketing, Product and Data teams, and help them trust the numbers. YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐ You are in the final year of a Master's degree in engineering, business, data or digital marketing (or equivalent), looking for a 6-month internship. You have a first experience or a strong interest in web analytics and tag management (GTM, GA4 or similar). You understand JavaScript and can read, debug and write simple scripts, and you are comfortable with HTML and browser developer tools. You know some SQL, or want to get hands-on with BigQuery. You care about data quality and details, and enjoy investigating why a number looks wrong. You have an interest in privacy and consent topics (GDPR, cookies, CMPs). You communicate clearly and are comfortable working with developers, marketers and analysts. You are fluent in French and English (both are mandatory). BONUS POINT : Knowledge of server-side tagging, experience with an advertising platform (Google Ads, Meta), or a personal project involving tracking or data. ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP: Start date: January 2027 Duration : 6 months Full-time internship (35h/week) Location : Paris (France) RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅 Skill fit interview and live case study with a team member (45min) Video-call Interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist (30 min) Cultural fit interview with the manager (30min) WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼 At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2). No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like: - A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously. - Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days. - Employe

jobs.description: This is an Atlantic portfolio company. Why we exist Every frontier model is now gated by two things: megawatts and cooling . Grid queues stretch for years, land is contested, freshwater is political. Far offshore, the wind blows stronger and steadier than anywhere on Earth, a vast resource the grid can, by definition, never reach. So we flipped the problem. Instead of bringing power to the load, we bring the load to the power. Our autonomous wind-turbine energy ships chase the wind across the open ocean and convert it on board into what the world needs most: compute first, then e-fuels to decarbonise aviation. 70%+ capacity factor — offshore wind that behaves like baseload ~€50/MWh target cost for firm, low-carbon power Zero grid queue. Zero freshwater. Zero land. And the ocean as the heat sink under every rack. Founded in 2025 by repeat entrepreneurs (with successful exits) and industrial operators. Backed by major international investors. First demonstrator vessel at sea in late 2027. The role This is not a sales job. It's a late co-founder seat. You will own Offshore Compute , our first and main commercial engine: strategy, product, pricing, customers and the multi-million-dollar off-take deals that put our first fleet to work. You already know that power and thermal limits are what will stall AI scaling. You're bold enough to believe infrastructure at sea can get around both, and rigorous enough to prove it to a sceptical buyer. What you'll do Write the go-to-market from a blank page. Build the global commercial roadmap, from first demonstrator workloads to full fleet monetisation. Land the anchor deals. Negotiate and close off-take agreements, capacity reservations and JVs with neoclouds, AI labs, CSPs and Tier-1 HPC operators. Turn variable power into a feature. Design offers built for wind-backed power profiles: fault-tolerant batch training, asynchronous inference, dynamic pricing, zero-carbon AI clouds. Connect the C-suite to the hull. Translate client requirements (SLA, latency, direct-to-chip liquid cooling) into onboard architecture specs together with our marine engineers. Create a category. Use our advantages — no grid wait, no freshwater, a direct ocean cooling sink, very low carbon intensity — to win premium pricing and long-term commitments, and establish floating compute as a new asset class. Be the face of it. Represent us at the top AI, cloud and infrastructure summits worldwide and make us the reference for next-generation AI energy infrastructure. You might be the one if You've been in the room where AI capacity gets bought. And you know the people across the neocloud and AI ecosystem who sign capacity deals. You speak the physics. MW-scale power delivery, PUE, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, thermal budgets. You can explain in one slide why land-based data centers are hitting the grid wall. You've built something from zero. jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Design Systems
jobs.description: Who We Are Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android , our search engine , and the DuckDuckGo subscription . We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai , which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place! Your Team and Role As a Senior Product Designer, Design Systems you'll be the first of its kind at DuckDuckGo. You'll audit our existing system, lead projects that move it forward across platforms and products like Duck.ai and Search, as well as shape how we manage and scale it as we grow. Applying your hands-on design skills, you will autonomously lead highly impactful projects that scale across millions of users, and collaborate with team members at all levels to pioneer new solutions as we build out the privacy layer for the internet. You'll have a voice in all product-related design decisions, whether large or small, and an opportunity to work on a team dedicated to our ethical, privacy by design approach.
